programme.title: Strach
programme.desc: Major Kalaš vyšetřuje řadu vražd souvisejících s minulostí. V pozadí případu stojí strach ctihodných občanů z prozrazení jejich temné minulosti. Na silnici u pohraničního městečka v noci přejede automobil úmyslně mladého, asi dvacetiletého muže. V mrtvém poznají místní jednoho ze studentů, který tam byl na brigádě. Do Kromperku přijíždí major Kalaš s nadporučíkem Vargou.

programme.title: Filmové minuty
programme.desc: Filmové minuty přinášejí souhrnné filmové zpravodajství ze světa filmu, aktuality, ocenění, výročí, nové a připravované projekty a mnoho dalšího z domova i ze zahraničí... Filmová publicistika

programme.title: Spletenec
programme.desc: Genetičtí inženýři Elsa a Clive tajně provedou experiment, jehož výsledkem je kříženec člověka a zvířete. Je to úžasné a podivně krásné stvoření, které by mohlo v moderní medicíně způsobit revoluci, pokud ovšem předtím nezničí lidstvo. Clive (Adrien Brody) a Elsa (Sarah Polleyová) se specializují na propojování DNA různých zvířecích druhů a vytvářejí tak fantastické nové hybridy.

programme.title: Ničivé tornádo
programme.desc: Tornádo je zlo, se kterým nelze bojovat. Nejde ho porazit ani zastavit, vždy vyhraje. Jediná možnost na přežití je ukrýt se před ním. A potom počítat ztráty. K záchraně života je třeba včasné varování, ale kdo by v oblastech, kde se tornáda běžně nevyskytují, sledoval, jestli nehrozí nebezpečí? Jen náhodou objeví blížící se hrozbu April Saundersová (Mimi Rogers), která se už roky zabývá zkoumáním přírodních živlů.

programme.title: Arthur: Prokletí
programme.desc: Alex je už od dětství fanoušek filmu Arthur a Minimojové. Na svoje narozeniny ho jeho nejlepší přátelé překvapí a vezmou do domu, kde se film točil. Nikdo z nich netuší, že jde o zlověstnou a smrtelnou past. Z dětského snu se brzy stává hrůzná noční můra. Francouzský horor

programme.title: Cesta za pokladem
programme.desc: Cesta za pokladem nebo mýty a legendy ze světa peněz je šestidílný veselý příběh pro děti o sourozencích Maxovi a Mili, kteří se vydají na cestu za pokladem, aby mohli koupit narozeninový dárek své mamince. Maxovi a Mili na jejich cestě pomáhá babi Majka a její pejsek Money. V každé epizodě se děti naučí něco zajímavého ze světa peněz a navíc zjistí, co vše může být vzácné jako poklad. Slovenský naučně-zábavný seriál

programme.title: Kikirikí
programme.desc: Kohoutek a slepička se stali nerozlučnými kamarády. Mají se velmi rádi, v noci spí vedle sebe na bidýlku a přes den spolu gazdují na dvoře. Kohoutek neustále něco vymýšlí, je nespokojený a slepička s ním všechno trpělivě řeší. Každý příběh v sobě ukrývá ponaučení, jak se stát lepším a neubližovat lidem, kteří nás mají rádi. Slovenská pohádka

programme.title: Kouzlování
programme.desc: Máte rádi kouzla, tajemství a čáry? V kouzelnické show vám renomovaný kouzelník poodhalí tajemství svých triků. Slovenský zábavný pořad (skryté titulky)

programme.title: Zabij nudu!
programme.desc: Dochází vám fantazie, co dělat doma s dětmi? Je tu pořad, v němž dostanete návod, jak spolu smysluplně prožít společně strávený čas. A také jak vyrobit jedinečné věci, které oživí vaši domácnost. Zažijete přitom určitě spoustu zábavy! Jsou to věci funkční, dekorační nebo jen pro zábavu, například pomůcky do školy, pokladničky či žertovné ozdoby. Slovenský tvůrčí pořad

programme.title: Staré pověsti české (12)
programme.desc: Animované Staré pověsti české vznikly ve vlastní produkci televizí CS Film a CS Mini. Producenti televize hledali velký příběh, který by připomínal tradice a naši minulost. Jan Werich o Jiráskovi, podle jehož námětu byl seriál natočen, řekl: „Kdyby Jirásek žil v Hollywoodu, byl by milionář, protože měl výborné zápletky.“ Oslavoval český národ, ale ne na úkor jiných. Tu a tam zušlechťoval naši historii a prokládal ji sentimentálními příběhy, a tak nám ji přibližoval a činil bližší.

programme.title: Mach a Šebestová (7)
programme.desc: Jednou na začátku vyučování přišel do třídy pan ředitel a řekl, že žáci biologického kroužku si mohou na náklady školy pořídit nějaké zvířátko a to pozorovat. Samozřejmě nějakým zvířátkem myslel morče nebo křečka, a to z důvodu přijatelných finančních nákladů. Šebestová ale dostala nápad si pořídit slona. Tento návrh nebyl samozřejmě přijat a pan ředitel odešel. Učitelka pokračovala v látce, a právě hovořila o pirátech a jejich ukrytých pokladech.

Karafiátova kniha s ilustracemi Jiřího Trnky inspirovala už celou řadu adaptací a stále patří do zlatého fondu české dětské literatury. Tato filmová verze Broučků citlivě pracuje se známými hodnotami a snaží se je co nejvíce přiblížit dnešním dětem. Český animovaný loutkový seriál

V té době žil v Krkonoších i poslíček Frantík. Celý den běhal po horách od chalupy k chalupě, jednomu přinesl psaní, druhému balíček. A je třeba přiznat, že Frantík byl poslíček pilný, přičinlivý a ochotný. Možná až přepilný a přeochotný, zvláště, když mohl sobě přilepšit a jiného napálit...

programme.title: Děvčata, nedejte se!
programme.desc: Situační komedie z dívčího internátu. Najdete-li za svými dveřmi koš a v něm nemluvně, neztrácejte hlavu. Třeba vám někdo pomůže s péčí o něj. Nesmělý středoškolský profesor konečně získá místo v církevním internátu pro dívky z lepších rodin. Před odjezdem na nové působiště nalezne před svými dveřmi nemluvně. Tajně se o dítě stará a studentky mu konspirativně pomáhají. Středoškolský profesor Emanuel Pokorný po dlouhé nezaměstnanosti konečně dostal místo v dívčím penzionátu na venkově.

programme.title: Pelíšky
programme.desc: Jemná poetika, humorná nadsázka a životní osudy tří generací ve zvláštním období našich dějin v roce 1968. Hvězdně obsazená retrokomedie o dvou svérázných rodinách od renomovaných tvůrců, režiséra Jana Hřebejka a scenáristy Petra Jarchovského. V dvoupatrové pražské vile žijí dvě rodiny - Šebkovi a Krausovi. Otec Šebek, prostoduchý, ale dobrácký důstojník z povolání, je zastáncem panujícího režimu a stejně vehementně obhajuje i vlastní neomylnost v roli hlavy rodiny.

programme.title: a zase ta Lucie!
programme.desc: Pokračování rodinné komedie Lucie, postrach ulice. Další veselá dobrodružství šestileté Lucie a jejích neobyčejných kamarádů, kouzelných panáčků z formely, kteří se jmenují Ferda a Ferda. Osvald, zbavený cti být vůdcem dětské party, připravuje strašlivou pomstu. Lucie se bude divit, až se zmocní jejích formeláků Ferdy a Ferdy a podstrčí jí za ně napodobeniny zbavené všech kouzel!

programme.title: Myš, která prochází zdí
programme.desc: Pohádka podle komiksových příběhů populární čtveřice, ve které se odehrává vše kolem zázračné schopnosti procházet zdí. Česká animovaná pohádka

programme.title: Kinosál
programme.desc: V pořadu o nových filmech v kinech každý týden informujeme o nejzajímavějších a nejočekávanějších titulech v naší distribuci. V krátkých reportážích se zaměříme na zákulisí vzniku filmů, kuriozity z natáčení a výpovědi tvůrců. Přineseme rozhovory s českými a slovenskými filmaři, kteří v našich končinách stále více natáčejí své autorské projekty, a zachytíme jejich tvůrčí atmosféru. Filmová publicistika

programme.title: Naděje
programme.desc: Syrový příběh dvou životních ztroskotanců, mravně nahlodaného alkoholika a prostitutky, kteří se po mnoha karambolech a ubližování sblíží. Na okraji velké průmyslové stavby 60. let se náhodně setkají alkoholik Lucin a prostitutka Magdalena. Setkání se postupně změní v citové pouto, které jim vrátí důstojnost a dává novou naději do dalšího života. 60. léta 20. století.

programme.title: Skřivánci na niti
programme.desc: Nevyčerpatelnost a krása života překonávají i ty nejhorší překážky v době bezohledné a prolhané diktatury. Lyrická groteska Jiřího Menzela o politických „provinilcích“ na motivy povídek Bohumila Hrabala z knihy Inzerát na dům, ve kterém už nechci bydlet. Satirický film z roku 1969 zůstal dvacet let uzavřen v trezoru, protože vypovídal o absurdní realitě padesátých let a odkrýval skutečnosti, jež měly zůstat skryty. Premiéru měl v lednu 1990 a na MFF Berlinale získal hlavní cenu Zlatého medvěda.

programme.title: Tři chlapi v chalupě
programme.desc: Tři chlapi, dva předsedové a falešná hlášení v komedii ze života pracujícího lidu. Tři generace mužů jedné venkovské rodiny prožívají spoustu komických situací. V domečku v Ouplavicích hospodaří tři Potůčkové: děda vdovec, syn, jemuž utekla žena, a dosud svobodný vnuk. Otec působí jako předseda zemědělského družstva, syn vede místní mládežníky a děda penzista ty dva přes troubel své nerozlučné fajfky zásobuje spoustou rozšafných rad. Právě mají spoustu starostí.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders (5)

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (51)

A difficult feat but can love prevail?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (52)
programme.desc: Mr. Bean is over the moon when he meets Mr. Pod because both men have so much in common; same shirt, jacket, trousers and underpants. And to top it all, Pod is Bean’s spitting image! Bean falls to Earth with a bump, though, when his girlfriend, Irma Gobb, finds Mr. Pod much better looking than him.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (23)
programme.desc: Mr Bean drops Irma off at the airport - she and Lottie are going on a lovely sunny holiday without them. To cheer Teddy up, Mr Bean has a brainwave - don’t worry, we’ll have a holiday right here at home! So Mr Bean goes about recreating all the things he saw in Irma’s brochure - a flight on an Bean Airways and a stay at Hotel Bean with sea view and a pool! Hope Irma is having a great time too…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (24)
programme.desc: At a funfair, Mr Bean wins a balloon for Teddy and ties it to him while he plays on the hook a duck. But he’s so engrossed he doesn’t notice his companion floating away! Soon Mr Bean is chasing Teddy as he glides and snags on various fairground rides. Will Mr Bean rescue Teddy before he floats away forever?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (47)
programme.desc: Grizzy gleefully discovers that he can print images taken with the ranger's camera which is connected to a state-of-the-art printer. He decides to immortalize and frame himself, but when the time comes to print his portrait, there's no more paper in the printer. The Lemmings have thrown themselves heart and soul into the regressive pleasure of paper airplanes.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (48)
programme.desc: A van pulls up to the ranger's cabin to deliver a full crate of jars of chocolate spread. While Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over a wrecking bar to open it, someone steals the crate. Grizzy and the Lemmings will have to carry out an investigation to find the trail of their treasure.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (49)
programme.desc: Like usual, Grizzy picks the door of the Ranger's log cabin to come in and make himself comfortable, but this time it's impossible to enter! The Lemmings have requisitioned the cabin for a party and barricaded themselves inside. Grizzy has no intention of waiting for an invitation to find a way to get in.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (50)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have got their hands on a pack of white beans which have very strange properties: when mixed with soda, anyone who eats them turns into a bouncing ball. Grizzy realizes that if he wants to take a nap, he must first get rid of the magic beans.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (51)
programme.desc: Grizzy wants to get rid of the old piano in the garage at any cost, for the Lemmings love using it to make a dissonant racket. But when he happens to notice that the she-bear he's in love with likes the melody of "Für Elise" he decides to learn the learn the piece like a real pro.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (52)
programme.desc: The Lemmings inherit a crate that fell off a Canadian army convoy transporting ultra-secret material. The case inside the crate emits a sort of laser beam that divides objects into multiple miniaturized versions of themselves. What if the Lemmings had to deal with lots of mini-Grizzys rather than just one big one?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (16)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over chocolate-spread jar lids, which they use as chips in a competition to win goodies. Indeed, next to the supermarket are two jackpot-style machines with slots the size of the lids. But more importantly, there's a key to be won that makes you eligible for the grand prize... the giant jar of Yummy on display under a glass cover.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (54)
programme.desc: At the Ranger's home, Grizzy finds a high-tech gadget that enables you to learn anything at all sewing, origami, Kung Fu, etc... within only seconds thank to electrodes hooked to the brain. He can now become the perfect bear! But first, he first needs a program to learn how to get rid of the Lemmings.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (55)
programme.desc: An old metal box found by chance in a recess of a cliff brings back childhood memories for Grizzy and the Lemmings.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (56)
programme.desc: How can one peacefully watch a documentary on salmon fish, nice and comfy on the sofa, when the Lemmings are playing chemistry novices with a fun experiment box? By confiscating their equipment? Beware of side effects.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (57)
programme.desc: Grizzy's TV remote control is stolen by a partridge who collects high-tech objects in his nest perched high up in a tree. This is a case of absolute urgency! Grizzy has no other choice but to requisition the Lemmings propulsion game to recover his possession. But try and make a Lemming understand that!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (58)
programme.desc: Grizzy has got it into his head to offer a butterfly to the she-bear he's in love with. But the Lemmings fight with him over the rare specimens he's spotted, for they want to play helicopter. The butterfly hunt is on!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (59)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have discovered an addictive new game based on the astonishing bouncing properties of the ranger's new running shoes. Grizzy, who is trying to relax, confiscates the shoes and soon realizes they are far more comfortable than his thongs.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (60)
programme.desc: Grizzy babysits for the she-bear he has a crush on, who has entrusted him with the care of her cub. There's no question of Grizzy tripping up, for he has no intention of taking any risks! But he hadn't reckoned on the Lemmings. Captivated by the baby's burps after meals, they dream of making it drink gallons of soda pop to make it do the "Big One."

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (61)
programme.desc: Unwilling to share the food both he and the Lemmings are wild about, Grizzy locks it up inside the ranger’s brand new and apparently burglar proof safe. He watches the Lemmings’ vain attempts to open the safe with amusement, until he realizes that the string around his neck with the key is far from indestructible.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (32)

Mr Bean turns his flat upside before spotting the bejewelled cat and gives chase. But when Mrs Wicket sees Mr Bean’s abandoned flat in a mess, she thinks her necklace has been stolen by a burglar!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (33)

Panicking, he decides to take them all home to clean them in his washing machine. But somehow he ends up shrinking them all, so tries all sorts of ways to stretch them back to their original size before Irma finds out.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (20)

Could he possibly have known his battle-axe of a landlady when she was a sweet and blushing bride? Bean takes us on a journey into the past, answering these questions and giving us an inkling as to what made him the man he is today.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (21)

Encyclopedias leave him none the wiser as to the identity of the pesky creature but Bean can’t bring himself to just abandon it. The puzzle is eventually solved after a picnic in the park and a raid on the local pet shop.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (34)

programme.title: Ben 10 (12)

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (27)

But when the bear refuses, the Lemmings ruse: they hide inside other coconuts in hopes of being adopted by Grizzy!

The imaginary invalid Grizzy is so convincing that the Lemmings fall for the trick. They think that the sooner Grizzy is healed, the sooner they will be able to throw him out of the cabin as planned.

Grizzy, who is not very good at games of skill, steals the tickets collected by the Lemmings in order to obtain the jackpot. The Lemmings decide to create an attraction just for him.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (30)
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover that oysters can make pearls almost instantaneously: just put an object inside their shell and it’s automatically coated with mother-of-pearl The game of marbles that the Lemmings have invented with pearls is driving Grizzy crazy. He manages to catapult the Lemmings far away. But at the ocean bottom, they discover a giant oyster. All they need to create a giant-scale marble game!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (31)

Jealous, Grizzy finds a fish too, but his is expressionless and indifferent to the bear’s efforts to communicate. Grizzy plots to exchange the two fish behind the Lemmings' backs. He puts the affectionate fish in an even bigger aquarium with a pharaonic decor and locks the lid. But the Lemmings have no intention of leaving their friend to Grizzy.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (32)

Grizzy and the Lemmings now fight over a valuable metal detector that each party needs to accomplish their goal: build a slide or find the beloved badge.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (33)
programme.desc: The Lemmings take a liking to an endangered crab on the beach and decide to shelter it from a seagull who is using its shell to open coconuts. They bring it home to a disgruntled Grizzy, who wants to watch TV in peace while snacking on Cheetos. When the Lemmings turn into full-fledged crab rescuers, the house is soon overrun with crustaceans. Grizzy decides to use the seagull to get rid of the crabs.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (34)
programme.desc: The Lemmings play pirates on a beached boat. Grizzy, who is fishing further down, realizes that with the Lemmings’ boat, he could come closer to a zone that’s teeming with fish. Grizzy takes a malicious pleasure playing pirate himself to unseat the Lemmings and steal their boat. The Lemmings discover a chest containing real pirate belongings. A telescope conjures the owner’s ghost who immediately places his saber and hook at their disposal.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (35)
programme.desc: Grizzy sets sail with his fishing gear. But he has no intention of fishing: it's a scheme to enjoy a jar of Yummy chocolate spread alone in peace. The Lemmings sense the subterfuge and sink his boat to get the treat, which sinks to the ocean depths. The characters dive in pursuit and discover a school of intelligent crabs that live in an underwater city. Their treasure is a substance that’s even yummier than Yummy.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (36)
programme.desc: The Lemmings find the cabin upside down. Upon closer inspection, it looks like an epic battle took place there. And Grizzy isn't here. The curious Lemmings start imagining what could have happened, visualizing the most improbable scenes for us. They decide to follow their lead to find Grizzy and confirm their zany theories.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (37)

By simply dusting yourself with its sand, you can fly!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (38)
programme.desc: Grizzy wants to watch TV in peace. The Lemmings have other plans: they want to have fun playing music with homemade instruments. Exasperated by the racket they're making in the garage, Grizzy destroys the instruments and sends the Lemmings flying. The Lemmings discover a magic ukulele that bewitches anyone who hears its music: the perfect tool to regain control of the cabin and get back to their concert.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (39)
programme.desc: Grizzy can't sleep because it's too hot. He decides to confiscate the fans the Lemmings use to power their fake spaceship. Totally into their Space Opera game, the Lemmings try to repel the alien Grizzy with "laser" party favors and are propelled onto an "unknown planet": a volcano crater with a secret base where a rocket is ready to take off. The rocket carries the cabin into space. It's no longer a game: Grizzy and the Lemmings will have to face the dangers of outer space!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (19)

Mr Bean insists he’s an expert but is made to prove it when they both compete for a trophy - the winner being the first to climb “The Big One”, a huge, scary wall for adults only! Mr Bean is determined to win but hadn’t counted on the competitive dad’s dirty tricks!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (20)

Mr Bean tries to show him how it’s done but manages to send the engagement ring flying! It lands in a bicycle basket, gets flicked into a pram, flung onto an ice cream - Mr Bean has to chase it around the park as it keeps being launched from place to place, in the hope he can save the day!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (21)

It’s all going fine, and Mr Bean is enjoying playing with his neighbour’s gadgets while he’s away. However, one day he forgets his task and has to let himself in late at night - but Mr Bean’s other neighbour, Bruiser, spots the suspicious activity, and thinks Mr Paliwal’s got a burglar!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (22)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is dismayed to find that the bin men are refusing to take his wheelie bin because the lid won’t shut as it’s too full of rubbish - and by the time he’s shut it, they’ve gone! So he sneaks the bin in front of other houses, hoping they won’t notice and pick it up. Meanwhile, Mrs Wicket realises that her purse has ended up in the rubbish, and is chasing Mr Bean… who is chasing the bin men!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (15)
programme.desc: The gang travels back to Ancient Greece, where they play unique roles in a Greek Mystery involving the mythological spider woman, Arachne, and her attempts to disrupt the royal wedding that would unite two great cities!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (16)
programme.desc: Shaggy's friend Amelia invites Shaggy and the gang to a party. But Shaggy discovers that Amelia has become a goth. After realizing he has feelings for her Shaggy starts to feel bad that he hasn't changed at all so he decides he too will become a goth. But a mystery appears when an evil plant monster attacks the gang.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (7)

Tom happily obliges, as Alfred's successful weight loss guarantees him a cushy spot upstairs. Meanwhile, Jerry aims to sabotage Tom's efforts.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (8)

The old woman is sweet, but she has a nasty little lap dog that bedevils Tom like crazy. Louella keeps treating Tom poorly, and Tom and Jerry make their plans to escape.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (9)

Tom is warned to make sure that Snooty doesn't catch sight of the pesky manor mice, lest she get upset or dirty her snowy white paws chasing the vermin. Tom is on it, but nothing goes as planned...

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (10)
programme.desc: Tom is watching a hypnotist on TV, when the words "you are asleep" hit him hard. He becomes a virtual rag doll and ends up in a jumble of junk for Rick and Ginger's yard sale. A woman who thinks he's a stuffed animal buys him. Jerry feels bad and hops aboard the car to rescue Tom.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (11)
programme.desc: Tom falls asleep inside a rolled-up carpet left out on the curb by Rick with a "free" sign attached. When the new owners unload their pickup truck and leave the carpet in front of their home, a sleepy Tom doesn't notice at first that everything is similar to, but a little different than, his usual surroundings. Soon Tom feels that he's landed in bizarro world.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (12)

Tom is now servant to Lord Jerry, and the Master wastes no time in making Tom's life miserable. Tom is caught in the act of exacting revenge, so Lord Jerry challenges Tom to a duel in the dream world.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (43)
programme.desc: Mr Bean buys a robot to clean his flat but it ends up trashing half the town.

Bean takes it upon himself to climb through in an open window and into the back of the van from where he starts to help himself. Unfortunately he soon attracts a crowd and is forced to serve a long queue of kids until all the ice cream runs out.

programme.desc: Mr Bean is feeling very left out when he discovers that Mrs Wicket is having a huge party downstairs and apparently he isn’t invited. Bean tries every trick in the book to sneak himself into the party - even resorting to hiding inside an enormous cake. If only he knew the real reason for the celebration.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (51)
programme.desc: He’s got her record, the poster and the T-shirt, so when Mr. Bean’s heart-throb, Roxy, is set to sing in concert at the London Palladium, he sets his sights on the only thing that will make his life complete: her signature in his autograph book. programme.title: Rido perché ti amo
programme.desc: Leopoldo e Amanda si amano fin dall'infanzia e sono pronti a sposarsi, ma il successo ha cambiato lui e i loro sogni sembrano allontanarsi. Quando Amanda riceve un'importante opportunità all'estero, Leopoldo intraprende un percorso inaspettato per riconquistarla e riscoprire ciò che conta davvero. Ci riuscirà?

programme.title: Speciale Tg1 - Settimanale del TG1 Direttore Gian Marco Chiocci
Smrtící hora
programme.desc: K záchraně horolezce chyběl jen kousek, teď jsou v ohrožení všichni. Aby zachránili svět před ničivou zbraní teroristů, musí zdolat nejnebezpečnější horu světa. Skupina horolezců pod vedením zkušeného Johna Deckerta zachraňuje horolezce, který uvízl na strmé stěně vysoké hory v Rocky Mountains. Jedno jištění povolí a Nikki, snoubenka Johnova kamaráda Solomona Daviese, se propadne o několik metrů. Nic by se nestalo, kdyby v úleku nevykřikla.

programme.title: Pokrevní pouto
programme.desc: New York, 1974. Padesátiletý Chris, který si odpykával dlouholetý trest za vraždu, byl za dobré chování právě propuštěn z vězení. Venku na něj čeká jeho mladší bratr Frank, policista s perspektivní budoucností. Chris a Frank byli vždy odlišní, ale pokrevní vazby mezi nimi vždy fungovaly dokonale a pevně. Chris dostává šanci k návratu do běžného života. Frank ho ubytovává u sebe doma a nachází mu práci. Chris už ale není schopen žít „normální“ život.

programme.title: Ghoul
programme.desc: Trojice filmařů se vydává na Ukrajinu s cílem natočit unikátní dokument o kanibalismu. Strašlivý hladomor v letech 1932-1933 tu dohnal spoustu lidí k děsivým činům. Nečekaně se jejich pátrání začíná propojovat s příběhem jednoho z nejzvrácenějších zločinců novodobé historie, kanibala Andreje Čikatila. Během 12 let spáchal přes padesát brutálních vražd, při nichž své oběti částečně snědl. Společně s místní tlumočnicí, průvodcem a senzibilkou se snaží odhalit tajemství domu, kde se vše odehrávalo.

programme.title: Fidlivareška
programme.desc: Kde bylo, tam bylo, za třemi horami jablek, za třemi vršky z tvarohu, kde se mák lil a mléko sypalo, byla jednou jedna vařečka. Tato vařečka měla kouzelnou moc a každý, kdo ji potkal, uměl v okamžiku vařit. Věřte či nevěřte, Fidlikanti ji na svých cestách potkali a ona je naučila vařit skvělé tradiční slovenské dobroty. Pozorně sledujte a naučte se je spolu s nimi. Dobrou chuť, fidli-fidli! Slovenský hudebně-naučný pořad

programme.title: Kikirikí
programme.desc: Kohoutek a slepička se stali nerozlučnými kamarády. Mají se velmi rádi, v noci spí vedle sebe na bidýlku a přes den spolu gazdují na dvoře. Kohoutek neustále něco vymýšlí, je nespokojený a slepička s ním všechno trpělivě řeší. Každý příběh v sobě ukrývá ponaučení, jak se stát lepším a neubližovat lidem, kteří nás mají rádi. Slovenská pohádka

programme.title: Kouzlování
programme.desc: Máte rádi kouzla, tajemství a čáry? V kouzelnické show vám renomovaný kouzelník poodhalí tajemství svých triků. Slovenský zábavný pořad (skryté titulky)

programme.title: Zabij nudu!
programme.desc: Dochází vám fantazie, co dělat doma s dětmi? Je tu pořad, v němž dostanete návod, jak spolu smysluplně prožít společně strávený čas. A také jak vyrobit jedinečné věci, které oživí vaši domácnost. Zažijete přitom určitě spoustu zábavy! Jsou to věci funkční, dekorační nebo jen pro zábavu, například pomůcky do školy, pokladničky či žertovné ozdoby. Slovenský tvůrčí pořad

programme.title: Staré pověsti české (13)
programme.desc: Animované Staré pověsti české vznikly ve vlastní produkci televizí CS Film a CS Mini. Producenti televize hledali velký příběh, který by připomínal tradice a naši minulost. Jan Werich o Jiráskovi, podle jehož námětu byl seriál natočen, řekl: „Kdyby Jirásek žil v Hollywoodu, byl by milionář, protože měl výborné zápletky.“ Oslavoval český národ, ale ne na úkor jiných. Tu a tam zušlechťoval naši historii a prokládal ji sentimentálními příběhy, a tak nám ji přibližoval a činil bližší.

programme.title: O modrém autíčku (2)
programme.desc: Animovaný seriál o dobrodružstvích modrého autíčka a jeho kamarádů. Český animovaný seriál

programme.title: O Mikešovi (7)
programme.desc: Animovaný seriál O kocouru Mikešovi a jeho přátelích, podle knihy Josefa Lady. Československý animovaný seriál

programme.title: Mach a Šebestová (8)
programme.desc: Kreslený seriál o příhodách spolužáků Macha a Šebestové podle námětu Miloše Macourka. Československý animovaný seriál (1976-1983).

programme.title: Broučci (2)
programme.desc: Animovaný loutkový seriál na motivy knihy Jana Karafiáta. Karafiátova kniha s ilustracemi Jiřího Trnky inspirovala už celou řadu adaptací a stále patří do zlatého fondu české dětské literatury. Tato filmová verze Broučků citlivě pracuje se známými hodnotami a snaží se je co nejvíce přiblížit dnešním dětem. Český animovaný loutkový seriál

programme.title: Krakonošovy pohádky (10)
programme.desc: Před mnoha a mnoha lety, kdy lesy byly plné zvěře a ptactva, vládl horám u pramenů Labe Krakonoš. Nejednou pomohl chudákům v nouzi a potrestal ty, kterým příliš narostl hřebínek. V té době žil v Krkonoších i poslíček Frantík. Celý den běhal po horách od chalupy k chalupě, jednomu přinesl psaní, druhému balíček. A je třeba přiznat, že Frantík byl poslíček pilný, přičinlivý a ochotný. Možná až přepilný a přeochotný, zvláště, když mohl sobě přilepšit a jiného napálit...

programme.title: O Dorotce (4)
programme.desc: Holčička Dorotka a její věrný kamarád papoušek Koko spolu prožívají různá veselá dobrodružství. Československý animovaný seriál

programme.title: Já Baryk (8)
programme.desc: Dvanáct příběhů, z nichž každý je věnovaný vždy jednomu měsíci v roce a jednomu zvířeti, se kterým se dobromyslný pes Baryk ve svém okolí potká, to je spousta veselých i napínavých příhod.

programme.title: Tisíc a jedna noc (6)
programme.desc: Animovaný seriál, jehož jednotlivé části vyprávějí příhody ze známé knihy Pohádky tisíce a jedné noci. Český animovaný seriál

programme.title: Pojedeme k moři
programme.desc: Jedenáctiletý Tomáš se rozhodl natočit o svojí rodině film, aniž by tušil, jaká odhalení na něj čekají. Režijní debut Jiřího Mádla. Malý Tomáš dostane k jedenáctinám filmovou kameru, po které toužil, protože se chce stát slavným režisérem. Začne natáčet film o své rodině. Představuje v něm tatínka, maminku, babičku i kamaráda Harise, který mu s filmem pomáhá. Zpočátku je to zábava a užívá si každou vteřinu.

programme.title: Kam čert nemůže
programme.desc: Svěží komedii o moderním Faustovi a půvabné čertici. Také jste měli někdy pocit, že o vás jeví zájem vyšší síly? Kam čert nemůže, nastrčí ženu! Úspěšný lékař a pragmatický výzkumník podlehne přeludům, vžije se do role Fausta a nechá se svůdnou Mefistofelou vylákat na hrad, kterému vládne šílený kastelán. Některé ženy mají v sobě něco mile ďábelského, neodolá jim ani zkušený psychiatr! Slavná komedie, která si pohrává s duchařskými, ne-li přímo ďábelskými náznaky.

programme.title: Voda čerstvosti
programme.desc: Perníková pohádka podle předlohy Josefa Štefana Kubína. Československý animovaný film

programme.title: Kinosál
programme.desc: V pořadu o nových filmech v kinech každý týden informujeme o nejzajímavějších a nejočekávanějších titulech v naší distribuci. V krátkých reportážích se zaměříme na zákulisí vzniku filmů, kuriozity z natáčení a výpovědi tvůrců. Přineseme rozhovory s českými a slovenskými filmaři, kteří v našich končinách stále více natáčejí své autorské projekty, a zachytíme jejich tvůrčí atmosféru. Filmová publicistika

programme.title: Lidé z maringotek
programme.desc: O velké nešťastné lásce akrobata ke krasojezdkyni. Hořký příběh o lidech kolem cirkusu a velké nešťastné lásce mladého jezdeckého akrobata Vincka ke krasojezdkyni s exotickým jménem Nina Gruzia. Mladý jezdec Vincek Bonžůr, akrobat cirkusu National, se zamiloval do krasojezdkyně Niny Gruzie, což se ovšem vůbec nelíbí jejímu otci Lotyšovi, jenž má s dívkou zcela jiné plány.

programme.title: Opuštěné projekty (1)
programme.desc: V šedesátých letech se na západě Čech odehrál podivný experiment. V opuštěném bývalém vojenském prostoru byla vystavěna vzorová socialistická vesnice. Mělo jít o příklad pro zbytek republiky, příklad, podle kterého budou stavěny další podobné vesnice. Jenže vše nakonec dopadlo trochu jinak a žádná další socialistická vesnice nebyla nikdy vystavěna. Český dokumentární seriál

programme.title: Nikdo se nebude smát
programme.desc: Tragikomická anekdota o plachém a slušném muži, který má problémy, protože se chce vyhnout nepříjemným pravdám. Mladý asistent na AVU odkládá napsání posudku na laický pokus o odbornou kunsthistorickou práci a zaplete se do zničující sítě výmluv a lží. Plachý kunsthistorik je totiž slušný člověk, jenž nenalezne sílu jednoznačně odmítnout dotěrnost sebejistého grafomana, který mu tak vehementně vnucuje své bezcenné spisky, až mu rozvrátí veškeré pracovní i rodinné jistoty.

programme.title: Sochařka z Poličky
programme.desc: Boccacciovsky laděný příběh o fešné manželce sochařce, která napálí nejen žárlivého manžela, ale i zamilovaného pátera a věnuje svou náklonnost nezkušenému tovaryši. Československý animovaný film

programme.title: Dnes naposled
programme.desc: Smutný konec jedné veselé party z malé vinárny. Byla to veselá parta, která se pravidelně scházela ve vinárně u Kroců. Tragické osudy těch, do jejichž života krutě a nevypočitatelně zasáhl alkoholický návyk. Sledujeme příběhy pěti mužů, na první pohled veselé společnosti z jedné útulné vinárny, kterou vede bezohledný a chladně kalkulující vinárník Kroc. Jde o lidi z různých společenských vrstev a profesionálního zaměření - Ing.

programme.title: Žofka a její dobrodružství (13)
programme.desc: Veselé příběhy podnikavé opičky Žofky Orangutanové a jejích zvířecích kamarádů v zoologické zahradě. Československý animovaný seriál .

programme.title: Vítr v kapse
programme.desc: První rok po maturitě začíná pro dva kamarády skutečná škola života. Dva nerozluční kamarádi Ondřej a Cyril, přezdívaný Cinda, nastoupí po skončení průmyslovky do velkého strojírenského podniku. Zde se srazí jejich školní představy a ideály s celkem odlišnou životní praxí. Oba mají své sny, Ondřej touží po práci na lodi, Cinda chce navštívit Paříž, kam ho pozvala teta. Namísto toho řeší nepříjemné pracovní a soukromé problémy a jejich sny nečekaně přetrhne tragická událost.

programme.title: V čertích službách
programme.desc: Honza se musí vydat do světa, aby si našel službu. Nabídne mu ji sám Lucifer. Po roce Honzovi služba v kotelně končí a za odměnu si z pekla odnáší - na radu čerta, s kterým pracoval - kouzelný ubrus. Když ho prostře, nadělí mu jídlo, na jaké si vzpomene. Honza přenocuje u lakomého sedláka a jeho hamižné ženy, ti mu ubrus vymění. Dostat kouzelnou odměnu zpět pomůže Honzovi skřítek, který mu dá hůl, aby zloděje vytrestal. Československá animovaná loutková pohádka

programme.desc: Příběh o vraždě a spravedlnosti, která přišla pozdě. Dramatický příběh z období konce komunistického režimu o mladém kriminalistovi, na kterého padne stín podezření z vraždy mladé dívky. Film vznikl podle skutečné události. programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (25)

Desperate for sleep as dawn is breaking, he fiddles inside the clock, only for it to fall apart and onto the floor! Can he get the bulky heirloom to a repair shop and back before Mrs Wicket wakes up?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (26)
programme.desc: In the run-up to a fundraising event for the Donkey Sanctuary, Irma realises she doesn’t have a posh dress, so Mr Bean goes to buy one for her. However, all the dresses are very expensive - but he comes up with a plan. He can buy a dress, then return it after the event provided it still has the label attached. Can Mr Bean protect the dress without Irma realising what he’s doing?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (62)
programme.desc: Grizzy is impressed by the TV show of a magician who transforms a partridge into a bouquet of flowers. To get rid of the Lemmings once and for all, for they exasperate him with their incessant games, Grizzy tries the magic trick on them. And apparently... it works!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (63)
programme.desc: It's hot out and when Grizzy sees an ice cream commercial on TV, he has a sudden craving. Unfortunately, the Lemmings made it to the deep-freeze in the garage before him and emptied it out to make themselves a sled run in the backyard with strawberry-vanilla ice cream. For Grizzy, there's no question that the stock they possessively watch over in an icebox winds up as powder snow!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (64)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have discovered a truly wild new game: an augmented reality program on the ranger's digital tablet. They move around the cabin watching the tablet screen, which displays obstacles as if they were really there. Grizzy confiscates this toy and becomes a fan of the salmon fishing game.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (65)
programme.desc: The only edible food item left in the ranger's cabin is a gorgeous salmon... which is stuck inside a block of ice at the back of the freezer compartment. Starving, Grizzy decides to melt the ice with the blow-dryer. Only the Lemmings are already using it for their latest rocket game in the piping system.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (66)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have unearthed a box filled with birthday

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (67)
programme.desc: Grizzy's last jar of chocolate spread was pinched by the Lemmings, who are savoring it in secret. To localize the Lemmings hiding place, Grizzy trains a raccoon, whose sense of smell equals that of a truffle hound to detect the scent of chocolate spread.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (68)
programme.desc: Wedged in his sofa to relieve his aching back, Grizzy balks at getting up. He designs clever strategies to do everything from a distance, including confiscating the Lemming's radio-controlled toy robot-transformer which he will use as a butler.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (69)
programme.desc: The vibrations created by Grizzy's snoring during his nap give the Lemmings an idea for a bouncing game. But when Grizzy changes positions and his snoring stops, the Lemmings must find other sources of vibrations. Only these are no longer compatible with Grizzy's nap.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (70)
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a birthday piñata in the ranger's living room. The idea of bursting open a papier-mâché statue with a bat like it says in the instructions pleases him. The Lemmings, who prefer to use it as a toy to swing from, are determined to stop Grizzy from destroying the piñata.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (71)
programme.desc: Inside a mysterious cave, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a magical Game of the Goose. The events displayed in the squares that the players land on come true in real life. When Grizzy and the Lemmings realize, it's too late to stop the game.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (72)
programme.desc: Grizzy is bothered by an object stuck in between the sofa cushions: a big fur lemming puppet glove. He puts his hand inside and has fun pretending that the puppet is strangling him. The Lemmings believe that the puppet is a Super Lemming who's stronger than Grizzy and start to obey it.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (73)
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers the leftovers of a Halloween party in the ranger's cabin, which was entirely redecorated for the occasion, with stupefaction. But if the curious ambiance perturbs Grizzy, the Lemmings are in seventh heaven and have a whale of a time jumping up and down inside a cooking pot full of marshmallows. Grizzy wants to get rid of it until he accidentally swallows a marshmallow and discovers the best flavor of his life.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (74)
programme.desc: Grizzy wants to give the she-bear he's in love with a plastic ring which he finds really swell. But since the object was found in the trash, he needs to wash it first. And the Lemmings are using the sole bar of soap in the house as a bobsleigh.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (75)
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a strange American Indian figurine with the power to switch the spirits of two living beings and finds himself imprisoned in the body of a caribou. He immediately tries to activate the reverse procedure, but the Lemmings steal the figurine in order to turn into a partridge and fly away.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (76)
programme.desc: While salmon fishing on the riverbank, Grizzy hauls in an unusual catch: an old hand mirror straight out of a fairytale. Instead of showing the reflection of the person who holds it, the mirror shows an idealized vision of his surroundings. Whether it be Grizzy or the Lemmings, everyone sees the world of his dreams, and no one wants to share it.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (34)
programme.desc: Mr Bean spots a cool remote-controlled car Mr Paliwal is selling at a yard sale, so he sets up a tombola with his own stuff as prizes to raise some cash. He’s raffling off some not very good things from his flat - the star prize however is his green car, so lots of people are buying tickets hoping to win the car. But Mr Bean has rigged the tombola so that the car can’t be won. Will he get away with it?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (35)

He hides in the toilet, crawls under seats and even climbs into the luggage rack! But can he avoid her until he reaches his destination?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (22)
programme.desc: Mr. Bean forgets the golden rule: never fall asleep in the bath when you've got a chicken in the oven. So what romantic meal can he quickly rustle-up for his luckless girlfriend, Irma Gobb? The cheese from the mousetrap? The flower from the vase? A meal is eventually provided by an uninvited guest.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (23)
programme.desc: The nasty tennis player is big and angry and wants his ball back. The one Mr. Bean managed to throw on the roof of a house across the road. Paralysed with vertigo sixty feet up on a windowsill, he is eventually brought to earth by the helpful intervention of a neighbour’s pet gerbil.

programme.desc: When Moley is given the key to the city, he has such a great day he convinces Manny to let him repeat the whole day! But when the day never stops repeating, Moley needs to find a way out.

programme.desc: When Moletown experiences a heatwave, Moley and Dotty hope Mishmosh can invent something to cool things down. Unfortunately, Mishmosh has "inventors block" so Moley and Dotty must help him get back his inventing mojo.

programme.title: Moley (8)
programme.desc: Moley must learn to Molerskate for the Great Mole Roll skating competition and discovers his parents have a hidden talent.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (30)
programme.desc: Lilit is finding getting some ‘alone time’ to herself tricky. So when she finds an old shell to hangout in the forest, she is rapt… and doesn’t want to share it.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (31)
programme.desc: When Mushpie starts coaching Sumush to become fitter, faster, stronger, it unleashes a new Mushpie: one who demands excellence and full commitment! Poor Sumush!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (32)
programme.desc: To Truff, making music comes effortlessly. So when he needs to put in a big effort to make a ‘forest song’, it affects him in unusual ways.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (33)
programme.desc: Lilit loves Chanterelle’s art so much. But when Chanterelle makes a statue of Lilit, she can’t stand it. Does Lilit tell the truth or does she just carry on pretending to like it?

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (34)
programme.desc: Our Mushlers learn that Mushpie absolutely cannot resist an adorable look. And now everyone is using their adorable power to get Mushpie to do what they want!

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power (33)
programme.desc: Hot Hot makes all the food extremely spicy and the accumulated heat threatens to blow up Professor K's volcano.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (36)
programme.desc: On the edge of the village of Catsylvania, Tom is carried off to Dr. Frankenstein's castle lab. Several lightning bolts later, a monster comes to life: a nine-foot-tall hulk with Tom's relatively tiny head sewn on. Frankenstein orders the monster to go terrorize the village, but it has problems focusing after Tom's head sees Jerry in the lab.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (37)
programme.desc: When Tom and Jerry go to a pool party at Toodles's place, Tom shows off in the pool with ridiculous stunts. Butch and Meathead arrive, adding more rivalry to the party. Soon, Toodles suggests they play a game of water polo, which reaches a fever pitch before long.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (38)
programme.desc: Spike the bulldog comes to Tom and Jerry, complaining he is being harassed by unknown creditors, ex-girlfriends, and other problems due to identity theft. They take the case on and go in search of who could be using Spike's name. It quickly becomes equally confusing for them to sort out.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (39)
programme.desc: A fast-talking sales cat named Dr. Jake L. appears to Tom from a trap door in the floor, selling "Ache-Eee Bones" tonic. However, when the doctor sees Jerry and Tuffy, he instantly turns into the slobbering Mr. Hyde-Cat and chases them, but then changes back to the doctor. Tom wants to buy the tonic but soon finds out what's happening with the visiting cat and tries to get rid of him.

programme.title: Batwheels (25)
programme.desc: When the Legion of Zoom plan to cheat their way to winning the Gotham Grand Prix, the Batwheels zoom into action to ensure the race is won the right way - fair and square !

programme.title: Batwheels (26)
programme.desc: Green Arrow and his Arrowplane, Goldie, come to help Batman take on the Riddler. Batwing is so happy to have another flying vehicle around that she brings Goldie to life and the two become BFFs. But when Goldie eventually has to leave, Batwing learns that saying goodbye doesn't always mean forever!

programme.title: Ben 10 (3)
programme.desc: Back stateside, Ben can't get into a cat cosplay competition, Top Tail, without a costume of his own; but when he goes Rath, a new cat-like alien with an attitude, Ben's newfound wild side quickly becomes much more than he bargained for.

programme.title: Ben 10 (4)
programme.desc: A trip to the South Pole goes upside down when Team Tennyson lands on the North Pole instead, but Ben quickly discovers the culprits: Solar & Polar Twain, magnetically-powered scientists who want to hold the world ransom by threatening to reverse Earth's magnetic poles!

programme.title: Ben 10 (13)
programme.desc: Ben and Gwen are excited to attend an Earth Day EDM concert in Portland until the show is hijacked by the sound-manipulating baddy Lord Decibel who uses sound as a weapon to trash the planet.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (40)
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a racket game linked to a prize distributor on a gas station parking lot. The more times you hit the ball without letting it touch the ground, the bigger the prize. With a series of 1,000 consecutive exchanges, the prize is a giant jar of Yummy chocolate spread! Grizzy has no qualms about cheating to win, but the outcome against the Lemmings is never certain. For they have nerves of steel when the stakes are high.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (41)
programme.desc: Grizzy uses insecticide and a fly swatter to get rid of vermin that are bothering him during his siesta. The Lemmings heal his last victim: a cute little insect they adopt as their house pet. Only problem, their starving mascot only eats wood! The cabin has lots of it, but when Grizzy realizes that an insect is eating his home from the inside, he takes drastic measures to eliminate it permanently.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (42)
programme.desc: Grizzy is too hot and proposes the Lemmings an exchange: their ventilator, which they use to propel their skateboard in the air, for a baby ostrich Grizzy found outside the cabin and who can tow them. The Lemmings are delighted to play with their new baby friend who is overflowing with energy. But the baby’s parents have a different outlook and do not want their son taking risks. Thinking that Grizzy is the Lemmings’ father, they hold him accountable.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (43)
programme.desc: Grizzy has played for too many hours on the console. His eyes are so fatigued he cannot stand a single ray of light. The Lemmings choose this very moment to throw a big birthday party with as many lights as possible! Grizzy goes to great lengths to settle the issue and decides to trip the power supply. The Lemmings discover a source of magical light deep in the savanna.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (44)
programme.desc: Grizzy watches the Lemmings play Hide-n-Seek and cannot refrain from sabotaging their game by revealing their hiding places. The Lemmings challenge him to play against them. The two sides outdo each other in cunning and trickery, but they are equally good. For the last decisive round, the opponents decide to extend the game zone to the entire savanna.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (45)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have organized a mega party at the cabin. This is obviously not to Grizzy’s liking and the bear throws them out. The Lemmings discover a cave where the party is even more fun, but their ruckus drives out the bats who seek refuge in the cabin. Terrified of them, Grizzy tries everything to get rid of them and understands that the most effective thing is the Lemmings’ ghetto blaster.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (46)
programme.desc: Grizzy needs the fridge to keep his fish cold, but the Lemmings want it to make ice for their miniature ice skating rink. When Grizzy finds a new model robot air conditioner that is both rapid and efficient, the problem seems to be solved: each party will have their own source of cold. But when the Lemmings activate the robot’s artificial intelligence, the gadget starts to feel a powerful love for the person who resembles him most in his new surroundings: the fridge.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (47)
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a white bear that fell out of a zoo’s refrigerated truck. After consulting the encyclopedia, he realizes that he and the bear are brothers of the same species! He decides to follow the encyclopedia’s instructions to the letter and take care of his brother during his hibernation. This runs counter to all of the Lemmings favorite activities. The Lemmings decide to create a false encyclopedia page which says that they too are bears.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (48)
programme.desc: The Lemmings’ hard rock concert is driving Grizzy mad. After kicking them out, Grizzy requisitions their ghetto blaster and listens to a relaxation cassette to calm down. The Lemmings discover an ancestral tree whose engraved strips of bark cast targeted maledictions. To recover their material, the Lemmings decide to drive Grizzy out by cursing him with the Ten Plaques of the Savanna.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (49)
programme.desc: Inspired by a magazine, Grizzy decides to redo the cabin’s interior design. To make sure everything is perfect, he ousts the Lemmings and their electric train. By chance, the Lemmings discover an underground futuristic premises in the middle of the savanna. From this secret place, they can see the entire savanna on a giant screen, down to the very inside of Grizzy’s cabin just like in a sandbox video game. By using the menus, they can have an impact on reality and thus... on Grizzy!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (50)
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a magic stick that functions as a Yummy divining rod. Grizzy steals their stick and finds a Yummy deposit in the savanna. To take control over Grizzy’s discovery, the Lemmings set a trap to draw the bear far from the deposit and transform it into an industrial chocolate factory. Grizzy will want to recover his chocolate deposit.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (51)
programme.desc: An eclipse prevents the solar panels from supplying the cabin with electricity and Grizzy is disgruntledbecause he can’t watch TV. When he discovers that the Lemmings are using fireflies to have a party withoutelectricity, Grizzy evicts the Lemmings and recovers the fireflies to fuel the solar panels. The Lemmingshappen upon a jewel that gives them total control over the fireflies.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (52)
programme.desc: The Lemmings recover a jar of Yummy from an automatic distributor but before they can enjoy it Grizzy confiscates the treat. In exchange, he leaves them the keyring that came as a gift. The Lemmings aren’t interested until the keyring lands in a magic vial which gives it an extraordinary power: stick the keyring onto any object and it will shrink to the size of a plastic miniature figurine!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (23)
programme.desc: Mr Bean drops Irma off at the airport - she and Lottie are going on a lovely sunny holiday without them. To cheer Teddy up, Mr Bean has a brainwave - don’t worry, we’ll have a holiday right here at home! So Mr Bean goes about recreating all the things he saw in Irma’s brochure - a flight on an Bean Airways and a stay at Hotel Bean with sea view and a pool! Hope Irma is having a great time too…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (24)
programme.desc: At a funfair, Mr Bean wins a balloon for Teddy and ties it to him while he plays on the hook a duck. But he’s so engrossed he doesn’t notice his companion floating away! Soon Mr Bean is chasing Teddy as he glides and snags on various fairground rides. Will Mr Bean rescue Teddy before he floats away forever?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (25)
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket has just inherited an antique grandfather clock - Mr Bean is impressed! But he soon starts to resent it when it bongs loudly on the hour all through the night. Desperate for sleep as dawn is breaking, he fiddles inside the clock, only for it to fall apart and onto the floor! Can he get the bulky heirloom to a repair shop and back before Mrs Wicket wakes up?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (26)
programme.desc: In the run-up to a fundraising event for the Donkey Sanctuary, Irma realises she doesn’t have a posh dress, so Mr Bean goes to buy one for her. However, all the dresses are very expensive - but he comes up with a plan. He can buy a dress, then return it after the event provided it still has the label attached. Can Mr Bean protect the dress without Irma realising what he’s doing?

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (17)
programme.desc: The gang gets caught up in international espionage and intrigue when they cross paths with British secret agent, Jenny Vex, and must help her complete her dangerous mission of stopping an evil mercenary called Minus from killing breakfast.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (18)
programme.desc: Fred's worst nightmare comes true when an evil spirit possesses the Mystery Machine and turns his beloved van into an unrelenting monster out to destroy him and the gang before they can solve the mystery.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (13)
programme.desc: Jerry is feeling lonely and wishes he had a girlfriend. Spike explains spring fever to Tom and they leave him be. Jerry's mood improves when he gets a message from his brawny cousin Muscles, who has fixed him up with his girlfriend's friend for a double date.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (14)
programme.desc: When Jerry's country cousins visit the Abbey, the cook is convinced Downton is in the midst of a vermin invasion! Cates (the butler) presses Tom into service with the threat of becoming a stable cat otherwise. Tom pursues the cunning, feisty bumpkins, and Jerry, throughout the manor, and they delight in making surprise appearances to Tom in awkward moments.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (15)
programme.desc: Jerry discovers the mysterious phobia cats have toward cucumbers and is inspired to try it out on Tom. After freaking Tom out repeatedly, Butch steps in to counsel Tom and help him overcome his fear, only Butch is far from immune himself. The two encounter more and more trouble as they deal with their phobia.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (16)
programme.desc: A dim-witted cat walks into the detective agency asking for help. It seems he has lost his marbles: He's the city's champion marble player and has either misplaced his case of lucky marbles, or it's been stolen. The cat is desperate to find them before the big tournament. It's up to Tom and Jerry to retrace the cat's steps and solve this mystery.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (18)
programme.desc: Ginger and Rick have installed a new birdbath, and Little Quacker has taken up residence in it. Ginger forbids Tom from going out in the back and has Rick move Spike's house. The dog and cat soon unite to return Little Quacker to the pond without Ginger finding out they're responsible for sending him packing.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (19)
programme.desc: Little Quacker develops the ability to sing like Pavarotti. But when Tom plots to use this to win a prize on the "Pets With Talent" TV show, Little Quacker refuses and Jerry covers for him. As things continue to snowball, it's up to Tom to attempt saving the day.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko (4)
programme.desc: Tom is enjoying his bath time while Jerry bathes Tuffy. Tuffy ends up floating off in a bubble and lands in Tom's bath. Jerry throws in all of the bath bombs creating a massive amount of bubbles. In the end, they all work together to get clean.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (48)
programme.desc: Mr Bean loves playing in the neighbourhood soft play centre - bouncing on the trampolines whizzing down the slides and most of all immersing himself in the ball pool. But he doesn’t like sharing the place with all those annoying kids. So Bean decides to turn his flat into his own private play area where he can play in peace. Unfortunately Irma Mrs Wicket and The Bruisers all want to join in the fun with him.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (49)
programme.desc: Mr Bean orders a takeaway pizza but when it arrives he feels let down by the size of it. So he sets out to bake his own unique Teddy shaped pizzas. Under the name Pizza Bean his pizzas become extremely popular and very soon business in booming. As a result rival pizza producer Don Crustyoni sees his profits plummeting and decides to make Mr Bean an offer he can’t refuse.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (50)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is not allowed to fly off on holiday as his passport has no photograph. After failing to get one from a photo booth he tries numerous other ways to get his photo taken including photobombing a tourist’s snap. None of these work but after Bean is arrested maybe the police can assist him. Say cheese!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (51)
programme.desc: Mr Bean wants to impress Irma by entering them both into a dance competition at the local park. But his tango is terrible and his rumba ridiculous so he enrols for lessons at a local dance school. After an unsuccessful class at the dance studio and a trip to the library to teach himself Mr Bean has lost track of time. He needs to make it up to a disgruntled Irma but will his homemade effort ‘win’ her over.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (52)
programme.desc: Mr Bean manages to get himself locked in a department store overnight while spending too long trying on clothes. Bean takes advantage of the situation having fun in the various departments. But when he discovers a robbery taking place the fun and games stop as the desperate burglar chases Bean from floor to floor and all around the store.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (1)
programme.desc: Mr. Bean becomes obsessed with gaming after being introduced by Mrs. Wicket's nephew. He decides he must have his own console only to discover how expensive they are. But as luck would have it he arrives at the shop at closing time to discover that tomorrow there will be a special sale. All he has to do is be first in line…

Bean accepts because he's starving hungry. How long can he keep up the deception? Long enough to fill his stomach?

Clumsily, she unwittingly puts an end to the show.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (15)

Her pride stung, she decides to steal the vehicle that allows her to be faster.

programme.title: Batwheels (36)

Mr Bean has run out of coins, so has to find a way of winning Teddy back without looking like he’s cheating!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (12)
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy are looking forward to seeing a once-in-a-lifetime comet - but it won’t appear until 4am! He tries to stay up, but it’s useless - he keeps dropping off. So instead, Mr Bean decides to go to bed and set an alarm - yet he over-winds the clock and it breaks! With all the shops closed, his only option is to build his own complicated version to make sure he doesn’t miss the comet…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (13)
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket makes Mr Bean drive her to the hospital to get her ingrown toenail seen to and asks him to wait. Mr Bean gets bored, and on a wander around the hospital he finds a spare doctor’s outfit with stethoscope - great Teddy - I’ll give you a check-up! But a nurse spots him, and thinking he’s a new doctor Mr Bean is asked to visit patients. How long can he keep it up before he’s found out?

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko (10)
programme.desc: Tom has Jerry and Tuffy trapped in a fish bowl. / Tom is at the movies, Jerry and Tuffy pop out of his bucket of popcorn. / At a coffee shop, Jerry and Tuffy are eating a strawberry cake.

Faced with this rampage, Baby Raccoon decides to block the baby lemmings and resume his housework, but the little baby lemmings have more than one trick up their sleeve!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (17)
programme.desc: It's a windy day in the Canadian forest, and Baby Lynx is having fun catching flying leaves like a little kitten. Meanwhile, the baby lemmings are discovering how to make kites out of leaves. When Baby Lynx sees them, she wants to catch them, and the baby lemmings have to be extra agile to dodge Baby Lynx's attacks.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power (37)
programme.desc: Colormad and Crusty use their Demolition Battle Vehicle to launch heroes through the air. Mighty Moo and Lockster initiate a chase to stop them.

programme.title: Ben 10 (5)
programme.desc: Ben, Gwen, and Grandpa Max arrive at a Native American national park to witness the Ayasha Plinths, an ancient Stonehenge-like rock formation. But when the sinister sorcerer Hex arrives, Ben must battle against a beast Hex magically made out of huge rocks!

programme.desc: During medieval times, Team Tennyson must fight to remember that they're not in the past at all but actually at a Renaissance-esque faire where "King Zombozo" has hypnotized its guests into thinking they live in the past!

programme.desc: While bird-watching at Pinnacles National Park, Gwen and Ben get into a competition of who can spot more birds first, but once a forest fire interrupts their fun, Team Tennyson must hurry if they are to save the bird population and discover who is behind the suspiciously growing fire: Hex!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (8)
programme.desc: On a trip to Japan to visit Velma's friend, the gang comes face to face with the ancient crab monster, Kaniaku, and attempts to solve a 700 year-old mystery. Meanwhile, Daphne accidentally becomes a viral media sensation in Japan!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (22)
programme.desc: Mr. Bean forgets the golden rule: never fall asleep in the bath when you've got a chicken in the oven. So what romantic meal can he quickly rustle-up for his luckless girlfriend, Irma Gobb? The cheese from the mousetrap? The flower from the vase? A meal is eventually provided by an uninvited guest.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (14)
programme.desc: Scrapper gives Bean fleas and Bean is forced to call in the pest control person. His flat will take 24 hours to fumigate. Bean begs Mrs. Wicket to let him stay with her. She agrees as long as Bean helps her with cooking cleaning etc. 24 hours later and Bean is desperate to see the back of her. The feeling is mutual. But then Mrs. Wicket starts itching …

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (15)
programme.desc: Mr. Bean is out shopping when it starts to rain. Taking refuge in a trendy coffee bar Bean is fascinated both by the brewing machinery and the amount of money people will pay for small cups of coffee! Scenting a fortune to be made Bean opens up his own strange successful coffee bar …

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (16)
programme.desc: Mr. Bean wakes up on a freezing cold winter’s morning to discover that the boiler is broken and no sign of the repairman. He tries increasingly ridiculous ways to warm up his tea his toothpaste and himself before venturing out to discover somewhere to hunker down and get warm.

programme.title: Lamput (33)
programme.desc: Skinny might be a man of science, but he’s more than happy to get his fortune told for a laugh. The palm-reader sees alarming visions of Skinny’s near future; mostly visions that relate to Skinny being squashed, smooshed or otherwise smeared. It’s kind of Skinny’s own fault; maybe if he paid a bit less attention to chasing Lamput and a bit more attention to not getting squashed, smooshed or smeared, he wouldn’t need constant rescuing by a frazzled mystic.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (9)

The idea is to pretend that the ground is on fire or of ice, like in the game “Floor is Lava.” They transform the cabin into a giant adventure trail. Depending on the card drawn, they must avoid zones on the floor with flames or wax. Grizzy unceremoniously gets rids of the setup to regain control of the cabin. One of the cards lands on a stone slab that transforms into lava.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (10)
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover a very particular cocoa tree with chocolate-spread sap! Reduced to eating canned Brussels sprouts, the only remaining food in the cabin, Grizzy is baffled when he sees the Lemmings parading past to equip themselves with all sorts of containers: ladles, soup spoons, bowls, buckets, basins, etc. He watches them through binoculars and discovers that they have planted a faucet in a tree where chocolate spread flows. Grizzy decides to siphon off their tree.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (11)
programme.desc: Grizzy expels the Lemmings from the cabin where they had built a cumbersome obstacle course. Peaceful at last and feeling lazy, he is determined not to leave his couch. The Lemmings discover a magic Mayan disc that allows you to choose instantaneous mutations of other animals’ features: bat wings, reindeer antlers, elephant trunks, etc. The mutant Lemmings return to the cabin, determined to continue playing their game while enjoying their new accessories.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (12)
programme.desc: As they fight over the last jar of chocolate spread, Grizzy and the Lemmings accidentally send it flying deep into the jungle. They both set out in search for the jar, but in a forest that dense, it’s an impossible mission. In a Mayan Temple, the Lemmings discover a magic bracelet that increases one’s sense of smell tenfold and use it to find the jar. Grizzy loses their trail, but finds some Mayan bracelets himself: one for eyesight and one for hearing.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (13)
programme.desc: Just as Grizzy is about to go to bed, he ousts the Lemmings who are holding a surprise party in the cabin. The Lemmings land in a Mayan Temple devoted to the moon. While toying with an ancestral console, the Lemmings set off a cosmic phenomenon that brings the moon, which is now the size of a disco ball, to the temple. In its aura, gravity becomes very weak. Enough to get rid of Grizzy and have a very original fiesta.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (14)
programme.desc: Grizzy does his best to get rid of the Lemmings and enjoy some peace and quiet in the cabin, but each time they come back with a new and even more-disturbing activity. When he sees some penguins marching in a perfectly disciplined line, Grizzy decides to teach the Lemmings how to behave in his presence. He locks himself up with them inside the garage, which has been transformed into an elementary school classroom.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (15)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight once again and cause an accident with Santa Claus’ sled. The Lemmings rush to the crash site and get their hands on Santa’s magic bag. While Grizzy is tidying up the cabin after their fight, he is baffled to see the Lemmings come back him, quiet and calm. The rodents break out into Christmas carols and prepare a delicious snack for Grizzy before slipping out again.

programme.title: Batwheels (29)
programme.desc: Buff makes a wish on a magic artifact for the other Batwheels to be turned into monster trucks, just like him! The rest of the Batwheels must learn how to use their big new bodies to undo the wish!

programme.title: Batwheels (30)
programme.desc: Bibi just can’t put down her new exciting video game, even when MOE needs her help packing Bam’s utility belt for a mission. Can she overcome the enticing distraction to save the day when Bam’s mis-packed belt goes haywire?

programme.title: Batwheels (31)
programme.desc: Buff tries to show Batwing how great it is to volunteer to help Gotham's needy, but the Legion of Zoom get in the way.

programme.title: Batwheels (32)
programme.desc: Condiment King takes advantage of no Batwheels being on patrol to unleash a barrage of ketchup and mustard on an unsuspecting Gotham.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders (13)
programme.desc: The Looney Builders build a science museum in the desert where Wile E. Coyote becomes distracted by the Road Runner.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders (14)
programme.desc: Mayor Leghorn hires The Looney Builders to build a water wheel in the forest where Porky worries about a mythical creature named “Big Feet.”

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders (15)
programme.desc: The Looney Builders build Tibs Squirrel a closet in his tree, but it won’t fit all of Tibs’ stuff and he doesn’t want to get rid of anything.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders (16)
programme.desc: When The Looney Builders enter a sandcastle building contest, Tweety sees the competition and loses confidence in his idea.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (3)
programme.desc: Mr Bean wins two tickets for an exotic cruise and naturally he takes Teddy along for the trip of a lifetime. Once aboard the huge ocean liner Mr Bean soon settles into a life of luxury but while showing off to a new friend Bean becomes ‘man overboard’ and stranded on a dessert island. The hungrier he gets the wilder he becomes and desperate to find a way off the island.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (4)
programme.desc: Mr Bean goes to his favourite china shop to buy a new cup for Teddy but when he opens his wallet he doesn’t have enough money to pay for it. When he sees a poster for the local funfair where the stalls have cash prizes Bean is determined to win himself some money on the Coconut Shy. But after many unsuccessful attempts he realises it’s a fix and lets everyone know about it. Naturally this doesn’t go down well with the stallholder who wants revenge and a chase around the funfair ensues.

programme.title: Svého vraha znáš (19)

programme.title: Svého vraha znáš (20)
programme.desc: Navzdory všeobecnému mínění je většina lidí zavražděna někým, koho znají, než náhodným psychopatem. Tato série představí příběhy zrady ze strany vrahů, které lidé znali.

programme.title: Zrod sériového vraha (1)
programme.desc: V roce 2021 získal Donald Miller nárok na podmínečné propuštění. Vrah čtyř lidí s dalšími dvěma pokusy o vraždu uzavřel dohodu, která znamená, že jednoho dne může být na svobodě.

programme.title: Zrod sériového vraha (2)
programme.desc: Vrah Jesse Matthew s přezdívkou „zpátky do školy" byl hvězdou univerzitního fotbalu, který si zvykl používat svou sílu k dosažení toho, co chtěl. V jakémkoli kampusu byly mladé ženy jeho kořistí.

programme.title: Zrod sériového vraha (3)
programme.desc: Ve svých 14 letech Todd Kohlhepp unesl a znásilnil mladou dívku. Byl odsouzen k 15 letům vězení, absolvoval kurzy a byl propuštěn. O dva roky později byly poblíž jeho domu zastřeleny čtyři osoby.

programme.title: Zrod sériového vraha (4)
programme.desc: Rok 1990. Ve Spokane ve státě Washington došlo během tří měsíců ke třem vraždám. O dvacet dva let později je Donna Perry zatčena za nedovolené nošení zbraní. DNA naznačuje, že znala jednu z obětí.

programme.title: Kontrola na hranicích Nový Zéland (1)
programme.desc: V Queenstownu vstoupí na Nový Zéland muž s temnou minulostí, úředníci Biosecurity mají plné ruce práce se spoustou masa a na letišti v Aucklandu přistane pašerák drog... Chytí ho celníci?

programme.title: Kontrola na hranicích Nový Zéland (2)
programme.desc: Celníci v Aucklandu vyslýchají Argentince z last minute výletu. Podezřelá zásilka se zdá být určená pro pašování drog v nákladním letadle.

programme.title: Vražda: Čas usmrcení (14)
programme.desc: Detektivové se při vyšetřování vraždy v Texasu setkají s jedním z nejméně porušených míst činu, s jakým se kdy setkali.

programme.title: Vrah v mé rodině (1)
programme.desc: Fred a Rose Westovi spáchali během dvou desetiletí nejméně tucet hrůzných vražd. Fredův bratr a neteř prozradí, jak jeho odporné zločiny ovlivnily jejich rodinu.

programme.title: Pohraniční stráž USA - Mosty (6)
programme.desc: Jednodenní turisté, kteří v Mexiku levně nakupují pilulky na předpis, jsou pro pohraničníky neustálou výzvou. Jeden nováček má úspěch při odchytu drog.

programme.title: Případy vražd (4)
programme.desc: Kadeřnice Joleen Cummingsová, matka tří dětí, byla naposledy viděna ve své práci v kadeřnickém salonu Tangles na Den matek v roce 2018. Poté její bývalý manžel nahlásil její zmizení.

programme.title: Neviditelné zlo (5)

programme.title: V mysli sériového vraha (3)

programme.title: Vraždy v zemi amišů (6)

programme.title: Pohraniční stráž USA - Mosty (6)
programme.desc: V podlaze nákladního auta ve Pharru je objeveno 840 kilogramů pervitinu. A u mostu World Trade Bridge jsou zadrženy aromatické svíčky naplněné fentanylem.
