programme.desc: Grizzy is disturbed during his nap by a few uncatchable flies which buzz incessantly around his head. When he realizes that the carnivorous plant upon which the Lemmings are playing rodeo feeds off flying insects, he decides to confiscate it and use it as an anti-fly weapon.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (60)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have unearthed a crate of competition boomerangs. They rapidly become pros capable of disarming Grizzy at a distance and ejecting him from the cabin with disconcerting ease. To compete with the precision of the Lemming boomerangs, Grizzy decides to learn archery and becomes the Canadian William Tell.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (61)
programme.desc: Exasperated by the Lemmings who prevent him from watching his favorite TV show in peace, Grizzy catapults them out of the cabin. One of them passes through the northern lights and undergoes a strange mutation: he now has the power to control metal with his mind.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (62)
programme.desc: A strange new object figures prominently in the cabin: a big wall clock that resembles a Swiss cuckoo. Grizzy instantly falls in love with the regular "tick-tock," which comforts and soothes him. But when the hands strike noon, figurines come out and perform a song and dance with a flourish. The Lemmings notice that by turning the hands of the clock manually, it can be noontime every two seconds.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (63)
programme.desc: Woken with a start by a nightmare filled with Lemmings, Grizzy stumbles on the Ranger's dream machine. It's a headphone set where you can program the theme of your choice before falling asleep within seconds for a night filled with sweet dreams. But who could possibly sleep soundly surrounded by Lemmings who want their fair share too?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (64)
programme.desc: Grizzy happens onto an old American India medallion bearing the symbol of the wind. He who wears it has the power to command air streams. Grizzy would be quite content to never leave the sofa again and control things from a distance, but the Lemmings want it to create fantastic new games that literally blow you away.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (65)
programme.desc: A magic horn lands on the muzzle of a moose, endowing it with grace and the ability to fly. It soars off, leaving a rainbow-colored streak in its wake. When Grizzy sees this strange creature, he dreams of taming it as a gift for his beloved she-bear, while the Lemmings imagine themselves playing rodeo on a bucking unicorn.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (66)
programme.desc: A magic horn lands on the muzzle of a moose, endowing it with grace and the ability to fly. Grizzy decided to catch him for impressing she bear while lemmings wants to play on it.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (67)
programme.desc: While looking for the TV remote-control device, Grizzy happens onto a box that can localize a bunch of keys thanks to its key ring, which is equipped with a tracker. Grizzy decides to stick the spy device under a jar of chocolate spread, just in case the Lemmings should decide to carry it off.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (68)
programme.desc: While looking for the TV remote-control device, Grizzy happens onto a box that can localize a bunch of keys thanks to its key ring, which is equipped with a tracker. Grizzy decides to stick the spy device under a jar of chocolate spread, just in case the Lemmings should decide to carry it off.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (69)
programme.desc: The Lemmings create a customized hang-glider using a supermarket shopping cart for the nacelle and a ventilator as an engine. Their aerobatics fascinate the she-bear that Grizzy is in love with, which gives him the idea of replacing the shopping cart with a double-seat and inviting his beloved for a sky promenade. But confiscating a wing in mid-flight is not within the reach of just any old bear.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (70)
programme.desc: In this fairy episode, due to a strike on the head and seeing the fairy story book pictures, the Lemmings believe they are the dwarves from the tale Snow White, and start attacking the cabin with pickaxes. After that Grizzy also believes he is Snow White due to same incidence.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (71)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings' favorite chocolate spread brand is organizing a big competition where the prize is a giant jar of spread. To win, one must make ten baskets in a row in a hoop set up on a supermarket parking lot for the occasion. Ready to play?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (72)
programme.desc: After being frozen for millions of years, a saber-toothed bear bursts into the cabin looking for food.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (73)
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover a top-secret Canadian Army prototype that allows you to pass through solid surfaces for a window of several seconds.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (5)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is watching Clint Chiseljaw - his favourite action TV show - with Billy, but Mrs Wicket orders her nephew downstairs to finish his chores. Inspired by Clint’s catchphrase - “Nobody gets left behind”, Mr Bean tries a variety of different daring plans to break Billy out of Mrs Wicket’s flat. But none of them work, until he hits on the perfect plan… or so he thinks!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (6)
programme.desc: Mr Bean peers through the window of the opening party of an art exhibition and sees free snacks being handed around - yum! But he’s told by the bouncer that he needs to be smartly dressed. So he sneaks into the artist’s studio and paints a tuxedo onto himself. This time he’s let in, but will Bean’s fake painted suit last long enough for him to get his free food?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (32)
programme.desc: Mr. Bean is delighted with his new ‘ship in a bottle’ until it mistakenly ends up on a milkman’s float. He frantically pursues his prize possession, only to see it disappear into a milk bottling plant at the local dairy. Getting it back promises to be a mission of the impossible.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (33)
programme.desc: With his teddy bear at the dry cleaners, Mr. Bean finds himself feeling lonely. Fortunately, a new playmate appears in the shape of a goldfish from the garden pond. Bean has a great time with his new best friend until, at the seaside, he discovers that some fish are gigantic, have large pointed teeth and fins on their backs.

programme.title: Lamput (4)
programme.desc: After a mishap involving a bucket of grey paint, Lamput ends up back at the Lab, working undercover as the newest Doc on the block.

programme.title: Moley (29)
programme.desc: MoleTown is becoming lazy and so Dotty helps Moley exercise, giving the Gardener an idea, he sets up a Golf Course to trap Manny, but things don’t go to plan.

programme.title: Moley (30)
programme.desc: When Molieres travelling spectacular comes to MoleTown, it brings with it, a rather unique guest, which soon becomes very attached to Dotty.

programme.title: Moley (31)
programme.desc: When Moley finds an old Movie poster about a human hero, Manny's magic conjours up an entire world of action and adventure.

programme.title: Moley (32)
programme.desc: Mona Lisa is hosting an extravagant fashion show and she wants Moley to be the guest of honour, but what will Moley wear for the show?

programme.title: Moley (33)
programme.desc: Things take a dramatic turn when the Gardener and Moley magically switch places, leading to a very bored Moley and a very tired and frustrated Gardener.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (7)
programme.desc: MM's favourite frog has had its home taken over by a lizard. Mushpot says not to interfere - nature must run its course. But Lilit feels so sorry for the frog she takes it back to Mushton where it causes havoc. Now our friends must lure the frog back to its home where it deals with the lizard itself.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (8)
programme.desc: It's Fool The Forest Day when Mushables pull pranks, and MM has an epic one planned. But they spill Chanterelle's painting dye and instead must replace it by finding a rare Sloof beetle and milking it for its dye in front of everyone. Wait a minute! You can't milk a beetle! They've been pranked!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (9)
programme.desc: When ants invade Fung and Miff's tree, our Mushlers offer for them to move in... but the two quickly turn out to be unbearable roommates. So when Fung and Miff break their trampoline, our friends decide it's time for them to go back to their homes. But first they need to get rid of the ants...

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (10)
programme.desc: Mush-Mush and his friends are determined to win the bark sledge race, but their essential fourth team member drops out. Our friends ask Mushpot to step up from being their coach to racing with them. The Mushelder is reluctant at first but soon reveals the tough competitor he is!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (11)
programme.desc: Puff doesn't like change much. And with spring about to burst forth and all the changes spring brings, he is puffing out nervous fog which is blanketing the whole of Mushton. Mush-Mush and friends need to get Puff to relax and celebrate spring together with all the other Mushables!

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power (38)
programme.desc: Kai visits Lancelord, but the castle is besieged by the latter’s former disciple, Excalibad. The duel will test Kai's evolutionary potential.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (60)
programme.desc: Peter, a pretentious cheapskate poodle, demands that Tom and Jerry help protect his precious sapphire egg on a train journey but won't pay their fare. The cat and mouse become stowaways and go to a lot of trouble to do their job, but the outcome is unexpected.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (61)
programme.desc: As Jerry and Tuffy play marbles, Tom throws a soccer ball in their direction and upsets the game. This sparks a chase between Tom and Jerry, and Jerry takes cover in a room that looks like a giant chessboard. As more chess pieces show up, Tom and Jerry attempt their best to outplay them.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (62)
programme.desc: After catching a crook, Tom and Jerry are framed, and the police chase them instead of the true criminal. Tom and Jerry must go on the lam as they try to avoid jail time.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (63)
programme.desc: Because of an injured foot, Rick stays home with Ginger's mother, Rosemary, taking care of him. Rosemary brings her infamous fat-free-dairy-free whole wheat gravy, and she quickly puts Rick, Spike and Tom on nutritious diets. Antics and fights break out as Rick and the pets crave real food.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (64)
programme.desc: Tom and Jerry take a case for Toodles' cousin in Hawaii, hoping to sneak in some rest and relaxation, but it's no vacation. The cousin's missing pineapple plant is only the starting place of the investigation as Tom and Jerry track down the culprit in this tropical environment.

programme.title: Batwheels (27)
programme.desc: After Kitty the Catmobile saves Bam when he's in a tight spot, Bam decides to take her on a ride along patrol in the hopes of recruiting her as a Batwheel - if he can convince her to stop playing long enough to focus on their mission!

programme.title: Batwheels (28)
programme.desc: Bibi wishes she could live a rule-free life like Jestah, so she decides to only focus on having fun instead. But when her actions put Batgirl in danger, Bibi must put the fun aside to stop Harley and save her hero.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (25)
programme.desc: Grizzy builds a look-alike robot to keep the Lemmings away while he prepares a popcorn party for his beloved she-bear. But his double¿s artificial intelligence truly leaves to be desired. If only it were as clever as the original...

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (26)
programme.desc: When she is accidentally hit over the head, the she-bear Grizzy¿s in love thinks she¿s a Lemming. Grizzy thinks that another little well-placed bang over the head will knock her ideas back into place. The only problem is that the Lemmings, who are delighted to have a new playmate, have no intention of letting him proceed with his plan.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (27)
programme.desc: When a meteorite falls not far from the log cabin, strange berries start to grow. One of their properties is that they make anyone who eats them grow to disproportionate sizes.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (9)
programme.desc: Mr Bean decides to do something romantic on Valentine’s Day for his long-suffering girlfriend Irma. But while he is secretly delivering her valentines card Mr Bean finds out he has a love rival for Irma’s attention. Bean steps up his efforts and takes Irma on a ‘date’ to the Valentine’s Fair only to find his love rival is there too! But will the fortune-teller’s prediction be the ticket to a happy ending?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (10)
programme.desc: Mr Bean has forgotten he's supposed to be cooking dinner for his long-suffering girlfriend Irma. He dashes to the supermarket to buy some groceries but why buy food when you can win an entire trolley full in an All You Can Eat Competition? But Mr Bean has some stiff competition - no one can eat one of Mr Magg’s pies quicker than Mr Maggs himself. Mr Bean has to think fast to win. But after all that eating will Bean still be in the mood to cook a romantic meal?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (11)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is in need of a sturdy new bookcase and sets off to visit a furniture warehouse. He finds one that’s perfect but is outraged when he’s told he has to build the bookcase himself! Bean is unfamiliar with flat pack assembly and struggles to construct his new bookcase failing miserably when he discovers he’s one screw short. Mr Bean heads back to the shop only to find it’s closed!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (12)
programme.desc: Mr Bean decides to take Teddy on holiday to the seaside. But when he arrives at his hotel a spoilt little girl wants Teddy all for herself. And her protective dad only wants the best for his ‘princess’. An on-going tussle ensues between Mr Bean the little girl and her Dad resulting in a chase across the seaside town and onto the pier. No one comes between Mr Bean Teddy and their ‘relaxing’ holiday!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (1)
programme.desc: In the series premiere episode, Velma's got an interview at the prestigious Kingston University, the most selective school in the country. The only catch? The dean wants her and the rest of the Scooby gang to figure out why the ghost of Elias Kingston, the school's founder, is haunting Kingston's book-filled halls!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (2)
programme.desc: Daphne brings the gang to a Victorian murder mystery party, so they can dress up and solve a fake mystery for once. But when an actual Headless Count (DAVID KAYE) starts kidnapping people for real, the gang must stay in character as they tackle the real caper!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (3)
programme.desc: Fred gets a call for help from Chuck Mangum (JOHN VIENER), his daredevil of a best friend, leading the gang on a rescue mission deep in the caverns of an ancient civilization. Once there, they learn of the real mystery: the ghost of the Tribal Warrior that still protects the cavern from outsiders!

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko (6)
programme.desc: Jerry is raiding the fridge but gets caught by Tom. Tom tries to get the food back, but Jerry and Tuffy fight back by throwing food at Tom. Jerry accidentally throws Tuffy at Tom and has to rescue him.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (1)
programme.desc: When Grizzy propels the Lemmings out of the log cabin perched on the Great Wall of China, the critters land on a small traditional house in a bamboo forest where they discover a box filled with fortune cookies. One Lemming gets super lucky after eating one. Armed with their magic cookies, the Lemmings set out to confront Grizzy. But each cookie represents a power… or a curse!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (2)
programme.desc: The Lemmings love sesame nougat but Grizzy, who adores this treat too, steals their box. Quite upset, the rodents search for more, in vain. Instead, they discover the art of energy points in an old Chinese medicine book. Determined to recover their sweets regardless of the cost, the Lemmings activate Grizzy's vital points and the bear finds himself completely blocked. Thanks to the book, Grizzy frees himself and learns to master energies in turn.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (3)
programme.desc: After a game that ends abruptly, the Lemmings fall onto the roof of a temple where they discover drawings of Tai Chi movements. When carried out, the exercises generate a ball of energy! The Lemmings test out the sequence of movements on… Grizzy, until he is evicted from the cabin and falls onto the temple in turn. His fall unveils a new sequence of movements on a fresco that could create an even stronger energy flow!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (4)
programme.desc: After being thrown out of the log cabin by Grizzy, the Lemmings find a dragon statue with a mysterious stone in a temple. Touching the stone makes a fleeting tattoo appear on their bellies, temporarily endowing them with the mastery of Shaolin Kung Fu. The Lemmings return to the cabin and uproot Grizzy with ease! But Grizzy has not said his last word and manages to get hold of the magic stone.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (5)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over the tablet. During their scuffle, they knock over an army crate which falls into the middle of the bamboo forest surrounding the cabin. Alerted by the noise, a peace missionary panda comes out of the forest and tries to calm down the worked-up adversaries. But will the limitless strategies of Grizzy and the Lemmings get the better of the panda's patience?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (6)
programme.desc: The Lemmings create a shadow puppet show where seven papercut lemmings confront a bear over a jar of Yummy chocolate spread. The Lemmings in the audience are super enthusiastic, but Grizzy is outraged by the treatment inflicted upon the bear. He decides to intervene and equips the paper bear with an armor and saber! The Lemmings retort with ninja effigies of themselves and mount an attack to recover the coveted jar of Yummy spread.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (7)
programme.desc: As Grizzy relaxes in the massage chair, a cloud drifts in front of the sun, immediately stopping the electricity supply in the log cabin. The voltage drops continue, even though the sky seems clear now. Grizzy looks out the window and a dragon appears on the horizon! Once over his initial fright, the bear realizes that it's only a kite flown by the Lemmings - using the electricity from the cabin they have rerouted!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (8)
programme.desc: Grizzy dismantles the toboggan built by the Lemmings in the log cabin and reemploys the bamboo sticks to build a jacuzzi. When the Lemmings discover the bear's piece of work, they imagine a giant waterpark dominated by an immense waterslide. Anticipating the Lemmings' desire, Grizzy tries to barricade himself inside but the rodents manage to eject him from the cabin. The bear comes back, protected by a super bamboo armor…

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (9)
programme.desc: The Lemmings organize a drone race throughout the cabin. Grizzy, who was on the verge of falling asleep, interrupts the competition but must contend with the rodents' reprisals. Thrown out of the cabin, the bear falls onto a temple dedicated to the Monkey King. He appropriates the statue's powers, operating a magic cloud by remote control. Grizzy settles in on the cloud and wins the race before the Lemmings. But a cloud that flies that fast can only arouse lust…

programme.title: Lamput (34)
programme.desc: Lamput gets mistaken for a guide dog, and the Docs try to nab their quarry without disturbing an old lady's pleasant day in front of the wireless. Good thing she can't see the chaos going on.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (1)
programme.desc: Ginger brings home a kitten that she will foster until she finds it a forever home. Everyone in the house falls in love with the kitten, except for Tom. When Spike and Jerry see that Tom has become a bad influence on the kitten, a dragged-out fight ensues. The only thing that ends it is the news that the kitten has a new home.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (2)
programme.desc: Fed up with Tom's cat hair, Rick buys the "Suck-Up," a next level Roomba-like cleaner. The Suck-Up patrols the house and cleans nonstop. At first, Tom enjoys the little modern mechanical marvel using it to clean Jerry out of house and home! But when the self-programming machine turns on them both and takes over the house -- Tom and Jerry team up to defeat it.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (3)
programme.desc: The storm of the century is brewing -- according to Tuffy and Jerry, that is, who are giving Tom a little payback for tormenting them earlier. Spike also gets caught up in the hysteria over the impending storm. When Spike uncovers the ruse, the mice must brace for their own storm.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (4)
programme.desc: It's picture day! Spike and Tom end up covered in mud and in the Laundro-mutt grooming van. A fight leads to a runaway van and a bath they both wanted to avoid. Tuffy and Jerry are determined to be included in this year's picture.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (5)
programme.desc: Rick blames Tom for letting a cricket into the house. He must get rid of it or he'll be sleeping outside. After Tom nearly destroys the house trying to get rid of the cricket, both the cricket and Tom are thrown outside where the chirping insect soon becomes Spike's problem.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (6)
programme.desc: Tom is determined to hijack the fun Jerry and Tuffy are having making paper airplanes, but the hijinks take a turn for the worse when Tom realizes he's made a paper airplane out of Ginger's great-great-grandmother's treasured fruitcake recipe.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (23)
programme.desc: Bean discovers Mrs. Wicket’s nephew and Bruiser Jnr swapping football stickers and decides that he wants to fill up a sticker album too. He buys-up all the stickers in the neighbourhood and has almost completed his task when Nephew points out that he’s missing one: the famous sticker owned by local footballing celebrity Jamie Studds. Bean turns thief to be the best collector of ‘em all.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (24)
programme.desc: Mr. Bean thinks he’s just dug up a valuable coin in the back-garden and goes rushing off to the Museum to have it valued little knowing that it’s actually Bruiser Snr’s much-loved but valueless fake gold medallion. Bruiser Snr wants it back; and forces Bean to break back into the Museum to get it.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (6)
programme.desc: When Mr. Bean finds a fly in his room, it's war. He needs weapons. Fly spray? A rolled-up magazine? These are only the start. In desperation, he enlists a mouldy doughnut, an encyclopaedia, an upside-down dustbin and a club-hammer. Finally, Bean becomes the first man in history to wage war on a fly... with a fridge.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (25)
programme.desc: Bean discovers Declan giving Irma a lift in his swanky new SUV. Bean is unimpressed until Declan shows off all the car’s features. Undeterred Bean professes his car superior. Declan issues a challenge - to see which car Irma will choose for her lift back to work. Bean decides his car may need a little ‘pimping’ …

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (26)
programme.desc: Mrs. Wicket’s Nephew is staying with her when he wins two tickets to an Outward Bound course. She refuses to go but then ropes in Bean to look after the child. The two start a competition to see who will win the trophy. Bean is a relentless competitor winning everything up until the point things start getting out of hand …

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (1)
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy have no plans, so decide to stay in bed all day. Mr Bean is determined that his feet can’t touch the ground, so he pushes the bed around with a broom. He has to find ingenious ways to make his tea and toast for breakfast, brush his teeth and an even bigger challenge of ordering a pizza and collecting it from downstairs without getting out of bed!

programme.title: Batwheels (5)
programme.desc: When Bam is covered in super bouncy Bounce X goo during a chase with Prank, he must learn to embrace and use his newfound bouncing abilities to his advantage if he's going to put a stop to Prank's latest scheme.

programme.title: Batwheels (6)
programme.desc: Bam must learn to adapt and try something new as he’s tasked to dive the Bat Big Rig all the way to Star City, while the Legion of Zoom chases after him.

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels (5)
programme.desc: It's time to go, go, go with Batgirl's motorbike Bibi as she zigs and zags her way to victory in this high-energy music video - it doesn't matter if it's a stunt jump or a speeding supervillain, Bibi always gives it her all and then some!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (9)
programme.desc: When the ghost of a small town's founder returns to scare off mayoral candidates, the gang decides to run Velma as mayor to bait the ghost. They quickly discover, however, that Velma lacks the skillset to make her a popular politician!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (10)
programme.desc: The gang travels to Britain in 1843-ish and runs into Scrooge who claims he was attacked by the ghost of his partner Jacob Marley and that three more ghosts are coming. The gang agrees to solve the mystery but Velma wonders if she has more potential than just solving mysteries.

programme.title: Lamput (43)
programme.desc: Specs and Skinny celebrate a brand new arrival to the family: a body lotion that delivers incredible speed to its wearer. Yay Science! The boys quickly include the speed lotion in their morning routine, because testing inventions on yourself is always a good idea. Then it's time to get out there and nab Lamput once and for all. Results are mixed. On the one hand, the "zoom oil" certainly works. On the other hand, these nerds aren't really used to having a body that can actually do things.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (13)
programme.desc: A magic tomahawk divides Grizzy into two identical bears with diametrically opposite personalities: one short-tempered, the other super-sweet. The Lemmings, who did not witness Grizzy's split, will have a hard time working out the behavior of their usual enemy, who seems to swing from excessive kindness to the worst trickery for no reason.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (14)
programme.desc: After studying a magazine advertisement with a couple standing in front of an SUV, Grizzy imagines that if only he had a nice car, his favorite she-bear would be interested in him. He decides to confiscate the Lemmings crate on wheels and give it a serious overhaul. The Lemmings have nothing against an upgrade, as long as they remain behind the wheel!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (15)
programme.desc: While chasing the Lemmings, who stole his jar of chocolate spread, Grizzy crashes into an arcade cabinet near the supermarket which displays a model fortune teller and her crystal ball. Grizzy realizes that he can foresee events that are going to happen to him in the crystal ball, and namely the traps that the Lemmings have planned for him.

programme.title: Ben 10 (23)
programme.desc: While in Paris, France, Ben catches Zombozo robbing the Louvre, but when Zombozo hypnotizes Ben to remain speechless, Ben must navigate a foreign land like a mime in order to stop the criminal clown and his travelling circus.

programme.title: Ben 10 (24)
programme.desc: Team Tennyson checks out a Samurai Museum in Tokyo, where Ben is too impatient to wait out the Calligraphy experience for the more exciting sounding Samurai one. But when a dangerous Samurai sword is stolen from the exhibit, Ben must take on its thief, the new Big Bad in town, the Forever Knight.

programme.title: Ben 10 (25)
programme.desc: During a tour of the Japanese Robotics Museum, Ben finds hero-gone-wrong Tim Buktu "trying to save" Tokyo from a Dragon. Has Tim finally turned over a new leaf, or is this just another one of his half-baked plans to play the part of hero?

programme.title: Ben 10 (26)
programme.desc: At Biggie Box Japan, Ben waits in an epic line for the release of the latest Sumo Slammers video game, Cyber Slammers, but Ben must soon save the store, not from game-hungry customers, but from Steam Smythe, who wants to retro-fit a massive mech with steam punk powers!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (9)
programme.desc: Sometimes Mr. Bean’s Teddy can be no fun at all. Feeling the need for a new friend, Bean buys a parrot. But getting the parrot past his landlady and her one-eyed cat, Scrapper, proves to be no easy task. Next, is trying to get the blasted bird to speak.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (26)
programme.desc: In the run-up to a fundraising event for the Donkey Sanctuary, Irma realises she doesn’t have a posh dress, so Mr Bean goes to buy one for her. However, all the dresses are very expensive - but he comes up with a plan. He can buy a dress, then return it after the event provided it still has the label attached. Can Mr Bean protect the dress without Irma realising what he’s doing?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (27)
programme.desc: Fed up of driving Mrs Wicket everywhere, Mr Bean decides to teach her how to drive. He sets up a practice “car” in his flat using tin cans as pedals and household objects for all the levers. Mrs Wicket does so well that Mr Bean lets her have a proper lesson in his beloved car - but Mrs Wicket gets carried away in the real car, and it’s a white-knuckle ride!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (28)
programme.desc: Mr Bean wants to take a photo of a rare bird, the Rosy Starling, hoping to win a cash prize from a nature magazine. But the special nuts he’s bought to lure the bird have instead attracted a couple of persistent squirrels, who keep hopping onto the bird table he’s installed and helping themselves to the tasty nuts. It’s Bean vs squirrels, or so he thinks…

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (10)
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings meet a spider and his web, which allows them to play like baby Spider-Man. They even develop a tree climbing course in the forest. Baby Beaver, for his part, has a hard time fitting branches together to build a bridge over the river. When he sees the construction possibilities offered by the lemmings' spider, he decides to steal it from them.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (11)
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings knock down one of Baby Beaver's constructions, bowling style. He immediately gets angry and sends the lemmings off to play further away. But he soon runs out of branches for his construction. While he is looking for new ones, he notices that the Baby Lemmings have collected all the beautiful branches in the area to build a natural bowling alley! Baby beaver wants to take their branches, but the Baby Lemmings won't let him!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (12)
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings discover that blowing into a leaf makes sounds that light up and even make fireflies dance! Meanwhile, the cowardly and tired Baby Moose is looking for a place to sleep. But as soon as the moon gets hidden, his fear of the dark makes him tremble and prevents him from getting any sleep. When he spots the Baby Lemmings' fireflies, he decides to capture them to make a nightlight.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes (9)
programme.desc: Squeaks has a last minute card game at Bugs' house. Bugs is thrilled until con-artist Shifty shows up to ruin the fun.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes (9)
programme.desc: Yosemite Sam needs a belt so he robs a men's clothing store. Bugs appears to save the day!

programme.title: New Looney Tunes (10)
programme.desc: Bugs comes face to face with Jack the Dog Trainer. It's up to him to rescue a pack of dogs.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes (10)
programme.desc: A boy bird named Boyd tries to win back his girlfriend through midnight serenade. A desperate-for-sleep Bugs realizes the only way to get him to stop…is to help.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (17)
programme.desc: The gang gets caught up in international espionage and intrigue when they cross paths with British secret agent, Jenny Vex, and must help her complete her dangerous mission of stopping an evil mercenary called Minus from killing breakfast.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (18)
programme.desc: Fred's worst nightmare comes true when an evil spirit possesses the Mystery Machine and turns his beloved van into an unrelenting monster out to destroy him and the gang before they can solve the mystery.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (27)
programme.desc: Envious of all the attention his landlady is receiving because of a broken leg, Mr. Bean decides to 'break' his leg too. When he ends up in hospital under the care of the Matron from Hell he discovers there are some kinds of attention even he doesn't enjoy.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (21)
programme.desc: Mr. Bean wants to learn skateboarding but hurts himself on his first try. Meanwhile Miss Wince is showing off her new mobility scooter at Mrs. Wicket’s. Bean is entranced. He could do wicked ‘ollies’ with that! He absconds with a souped-up scooter and heads straight to the skate park ready to challenge Bruiser Senior and Junior …

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (9)
programme.desc: When Jerry ventures out of his hole for a late night snack, Tom has a trap set for him. Unfortunately for Tom, he falls into his own trap and gets his head stuck through the wall and into Jerry's house. Jerry tries everything he can to dislodge Tom, and almost gives up hope of ever getting his privacy back.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (10)
programme.desc: Detectives Tom and Jerry are hired by Polly the Dog to get back her collar from mean Barkley at the park. After a series of incidents involving the pound "jail" and an electric fence, Barkley reforms when he meets Polly and falls in love with her.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko (5)
programme.desc: It’s the middle of the night and Tom plays makeshift instruments creating loud music that wakes up Jerry. Jerry tries to put an end to Tom's concert with no success. Tuffy wakes up and goes along with the music. Jerry decides to join in on the fun.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (40)
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a racket game linked to a prize distributor on a gas station parking lot. The more times you hit the ball without letting it touch the ground, the bigger the prize. With a series of 1,000 consecutive exchanges, the prize is a giant jar of Yummy chocolate spread! Grizzy has no qualms about cheating to win, but the outcome against the Lemmings is never certain. For they have nerves of steel when the stakes are high.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (41)
programme.desc: Grizzy uses insecticide and a fly swatter to get rid of vermin that are bothering him during his siesta. The Lemmings heal his last victim: a cute little insect they adopt as their house pet. Only problem, their starving mascot only eats wood! The cabin has lots of it, but when Grizzy realizes that an insect is eating his home from the inside, he takes drastic measures to eliminate it permanently.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (42)
programme.desc: Grizzy is too hot and proposes the Lemmings an exchange: their ventilator, which they use to propel their skateboard in the air, for a baby ostrich Grizzy found outside the cabin and who can tow them. The Lemmings are delighted to play with their new baby friend who is overflowing with energy. But the baby’s parents have a different outlook and do not want their son taking risks. Thinking that Grizzy is the Lemmings’ father, they hold him accountable.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (43)
programme.desc: Grizzy has played for too many hours on the console. His eyes are so fatigued he cannot stand a single ray of light. The Lemmings choose this very moment to throw a big birthday party with as many lights as possible! Grizzy goes to great lengths to settle the issue and decides to trip the power supply. The Lemmings discover a source of magical light deep in the savanna.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (44)
programme.desc: Grizzy watches the Lemmings play Hide-n-Seek and cannot refrain from sabotaging their game by revealing their hiding places. The Lemmings challenge him to play against them. The two sides outdo each other in cunning and trickery, but they are equally good. For the last decisive round, the opponents decide to extend the game zone to the entire savanna.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (45)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have organized a mega party at the cabin. This is obviously not to Grizzy’s liking and the bear throws them out. The Lemmings discover a cave where the party is even more fun, but their ruckus drives out the bats who seek refuge in the cabin. Terrified of them, Grizzy tries everything to get rid of them and understands that the most effective thing is the Lemmings’ ghetto blaster.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power (5)
programme.desc: Kid Fury faces Mr. King’s three challenges to prove his worth and show that he is the strongest.

programme.title: Batwheels (9)
programme.desc: When the Batwheels celebrate their mutual birthdays together in the park, party games that should be fun start to go mysteriously wrong.

programme.title: Batwheels (10)
programme.desc: Batman, Buff, and Ace put their new firefighter training to the test when a magical fire breaks out in Poison Ivy’s fortress.

programme.title: Batwheels (1)
programme.desc: When Batman, Robin, and Batgirl are all captured, the Batcomputer brings the Bat-Vehicles to life. Now the newly-minted Batwheels must defend the Batcave and face off with the Legion of Zoom… all without Batman’s help!

programme.title: Batwheels (2)
programme.desc: With Batman, Robin, and Batgirl unreachable, Batcomputer brings Batman’s trusty Batmobile, Bam, to life to help protect the Batcave from a mysterious intruder.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders (33)
programme.desc: The Looney Builders build a skate park for the kids, but it soon interferes with Hoots Talon and his friends’ activities.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders (34)
programme.desc: As The Looney Builders build Kathy Bat an upside-down radio station, Porky has concerns but doesn’t speak up.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders (35)
programme.desc: Queen Beatrice hires The Looney Builders to build a workshop in her beehive where there is one rule the crew has trouble following.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders (36)
programme.desc: Prince Lionel of England hires The Looney Builders to build him a party room for his birthday, then proceeds to boss the crew around.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (13)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is left in peace when Mrs Wicket goes off on her holidays. This means Mr Bean has free access to her daily newspaper. But every time he goes down to collect it from the letterbox it disappears. Someone is taking it but who? Mr Bean is determined to nab the mysterious newspaper stealer and uses a range of ingenious homemade traps in his quest to catch the sneaky thief.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (14)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is trying to find a nice quiet place to read his book so he sets off for the Library. But instead of reading he becomes distracted by some funny online videos he sees on the Library’s computer. Before he knows it Mr Bean is recording his own video which is uploaded for everyone to see. Things start to go crazy when people check out his funny video and his popularity takes off. But does Mr Bean enjoy being in the public eye and how long will his celebrity last?

programme.title: Spravedlnost podle kultu (1)
programme.desc: Tony Alamo a jeho manželka Susan vedli hollywoodskou sektu, kde vykořisťovali své stoupence a navrhovali bundy pro celebrity. Desiree Kolbek přežila a její svědectví vedlo k odsouzení na 175 let.

programme.title: Pohraniční stráž USA - Mosty (5)
programme.desc: Když dají psi u jednoho vozidla výstrahu, všichni se pustí do podrobné kontroly. Vozidlo na odlehlém mostě Laredo Colombia Solidarity Bridge má podezřelé předměty v palivové nádrži.

programme.title: Vražda: Čas usmrcení (18)
programme.desc: Když hasiči v texaském Arlingtonu uhasí plameny požáru, objeví v bytě ohořelé ostatky devatenáctileté Missy Grubaughové.

programme.title: Vrah v mé rodině (6)
programme.desc: Phillip Fraser v roce 1997 zavraždil svou bývalou partnerku. Jeho dcera vzpomíná na dané události a vypráví, jak ji ovlivnilo svědectví o následcích zločinu.

programme.title: Náhodné vraždy (10)
programme.desc: V únoru 2017 odešla Reagan Tokesová, 21letá studentka psychologie na Ohio State University, z práce v místní restauraci. Následně ji unesl 32letý sexuální delikvent Brian Golsby.

programme.title: Pohraniční stráž USA - Mosty (10)
programme.desc: Nová posila se vyznamená, když najde v autě kokain. Úředníci celní a pohraniční ochrany také hledají unesené dítě, ale policie se obává, že bylo propašováno přes hranice.

programme.title: Vraždy, které šokovaly (25)
programme.desc: Náhlé zmizení manžela a otce pěti dětí z Hendersonu v Nevadě vynese během dvouletého pátrání po důkazech a pravdě na světlo nevěru a tajnosti.

programme.title: Vraždy, které šokovaly (26)
programme.desc: Detektivové mají v případu vraždy mladé dospívající matky několik podezřelých, ale když se skutečný vrah ukáže před kamerou, zaskočí je to.

programme.title: Vraždící páry (1)
programme.desc: Ve jejich domě jsou nalezena těla zastřeleného páru. Policie pronásleduje dvojici ke všemu odhodlaných milenců po všech státech USA.

programme.title: Vraždící páry (2)
programme.desc: Po kempování s přáteli je nalezeno tělo zavražděné mladé ženy, jež vykazuje stopy mučení. Policie musí rozřešit protichůdné příběhy dvou párů, aby přivedla vrahy před spravedlnost.

programme.title: Vraždící páry (3)
programme.desc: V Charlestonu zmizí mladá dáma z lepší společnosti. Vyšetřovatelé odhalí šokující zradu ze strany jejích dvou nejlepších přátel, z nichž jeden je podvodník se smrtícím tajemstvím.

programme.title: Vraždící páry (4)
programme.desc: Ve svém domě je nalezena zavražděná svobodná matka. Vyšetřování odhalí milostný trojúhelník a plán na vraždu na objednávku, jehož cílem bylo zabít konkurenci.

programme.title: Vraždy v zemi amišů (2)
programme.desc: Když je u venkovské dálnice nalezeno tělo devítiletého chlapce, trvá policii dva roky, než ho identifikuje. Ale stále je to jen začátek mnohem delšího a zamotanějšího vyšetřování.

programme.title: Vraždy v zemi amišů (3)
programme.desc: Amišská matka čtyř dětí z Missouri Anna Borntregerová zemře v důsledku selhání jater. Vdovec Samuel Borntreger se po deseti letech přizná k její vraždě a ohromí tím detektivy.

programme.title: Vraždy v zemi amišů (4)
programme.desc: Když je nalezena zavražděná amišská žena Katie Gingerichová, která byla metodicky vykuchána, jsou i ti nejzatvrzelejší policisté šokováni brutalitou zločinu.

programme.title: Vraždy v zemi amišů (5)
programme.desc: Naomi Huyardová se nikdy nevzdaluje daleko od domova. Když jedné noci v New Hollandu v Pensylvánii náhle zmizí, vzbudí to mezi amišskou komunitou poplach.

programme.title: Vraždy v zemi amišů (6)
programme.desc: Když je muž z mennonitské rodiny Abraham Wiebe zastaven na oklahomském venkově za jízdu pod vlivem alkoholu, nikdo netušil, že se tím odhalí šokující obrovský obchod s drogami.

programme.title: Pohraniční stráž USA - Mosty (6)
programme.desc: V podlaze nákladního auta ve Pharru je objeveno 840 kilogramů pervitinu. A u mostu World Trade Bridge jsou zadrženy aromatické svíčky naplněné fentanylem.

programme.title: Pohraniční stráž USA - Mosty (7)
programme.desc: Dva šestnáctiletí mladíci jsou podezřelí z pašování drog pro kartel. Jeden muž se pokusí vstoupit do USA s falešnými doklady. A v rolích koberce je nalezena marihuana v hodnotě sedmi milionů dolarů.

programme.title: Pohraniční stráž USA - Mosty (8)
programme.desc: Ve stěně přívěsu jsou nalezeny balíčky pervitinu. Dva bratři jsou přistiženi při pašování pilulek. A také jsou zadrženy zakázané mexické pochoutky.

programme.title: Pohraniční stráž USA - Mosty (9)
programme.desc: V Progresu je přistižena dvacetiletá žena při pašování pilulek. A v Laredu je nalezeno 500 kilogramů marihuany ukrytých v zásilce kuchyňského nádobí.

programme.title: Pohraniční stráž USA - Mosty (10)
programme.desc: Ve reproduktoru v nákladním autě je nalezen pervitin. Mexický chlapec je vyslýchán poté, co se přihlásil k americkému občanství. A jedna dívka je přistižena při pašování tramadolu.

programme.title: Ponechána smrti - příběh Ashley Reevesové
programme.desc: V roce 2006 byla sedmnáctiletá Ashley Reevesová po brutálním útoku ponechána v lese napospas smrti. Bez jakékoli vzpomínky na to, co se stalo, začíná dlouhou a bolestivou cestu k uzdravení.

programme.title: Vražda v Tokiu : Případ Lucie Blackmanové
programme.desc: Tokio, rok 2000: Britská hosteska Lucie Blackman se ztratí. Policie případ zpočátku nebere vážně, dokud její otec nedonutí celý svět, aby se o něj začal zajímat - a stopa vede k sériovému násilníkovi.

programme.title: La Notte dei Serpenti
programme.desc: Il concertone torna come un grande evento spettacolare capace di accendere i sensi e raccontare l'Abruzzo attraverso la forza della musica e della condivisione. Un concerto che è rito collettivo, dove il suono diventa racconto e la tradizione si trasforma in emozione viva. Sul palco, le nuove voci della scena musicale si intrecciano con i cori e i cantori della tradizione, dando vita a un dialogo potente tra passato e presente.

programme.title: Codice - La vita è digitale - Puntata del 04/09/2026
programme.desc: Barbara Carfagna e i suoi ospiti - esperti di tecnologie, docenti universitari e scienziati - approfondiscono i nuovi sovranismi digitali: cloud nazionali, chip, dati, infrastrutture e modelli linguistici che diventano strumenti di autonomia politica e di competizione globale.

programme.title: Cinematografo - Speciale 83a Mostra Internazionale d'Arte Cinematografica di Venezia
programme.desc: 83a Edizione mostra internazionale d'arte cinematografica. Cinque puntate speciali di Cinematografo per la Biennale Cinema 2026 che si svolgerà dal 02 al 12 settembre a Venezia.

programme.title: Reazione a catena - Puntata del 04/09/2026
programme.desc: Il gioco che, utilizzando l'associazione logica di parole, mette alla prova la padronanza della lingua italiana di concorrenti e telespettatori. Due squadre composte da 3 giocatori si sfidano sulla loro capacità di indovinare, formare, completare e ordinare parole e "catene" di vocaboli.

programme.title: Domino
programme.desc: Nejlepší zbraní proti nepříteli je další nepřítel... Během rutinní policejní hlídky je Christian Toft se svým kolegou povolán ke zdánlivě obyčejné události domácího násilí. Případ ale vezme za své, jakmile vyjde najevo, že brutální okolnosti případu jsou přímo spojeny s plánovanými teroristickými útoky. Christian se vydává na cestu msty za Libyjcem Ezrou Tarzím, který ale sám pronásleduje fanatického vůdce, Salaha al-Dina.

programme.title: Projekt Cat City
programme.desc: Manželský trojúhelník - to je nevěra a zrada. Ale když jde o miliony a dojde k vraždě, je to ještě láska? Co se stane, když mezi přátele spadne několik milionů dolarů? Příběh o nevěře, zradě, chamtivosti a vraždě. Nick, developer v Palm Springs, podvádí svou manželku Victorii s právničkou Samanthou. Nick se Samanthou mají kromě milostné aférky společného mnohem více - podvodný projekt, na kterém vydělají miliony dolarů.

programme.title: Poker Face
programme.desc: Miliardář a hráč pokeru Jake Foley (Russell Crowe) zve každým rokem přátele z dětství do svého sídla v Sydney zahrát si poker s vysokými sázkami. Tentokrát je to jiné. Má svůj plán a tím je pomsta za jejich zrady. Nabízí jim šanci vyhrát astronomickou sumu pod jednou podmínkou: Aby mohli hrát, budou se muset vzdát toho, co celý život pečlivě chrání - svých skrytých tajemství. Když jim Jake plán odhalí, nastane chaos… Americko - australsko - britský thriller

programme.title: Fidlivareška
programme.desc: Kde bylo, tam bylo, za třemi horami jablek, za třemi vršky z tvarohu, kde se mák lil a mléko sypalo, byla jednou jedna vařečka. Tato vařečka měla kouzelnou moc a každý, kdo ji potkal, uměl v okamžiku vařit. Věřte či nevěřte, Fidlikanti ji na svých cestách potkali a ona je naučila vařit skvělé tradiční slovenské dobroty. Pozorně sledujte a naučte se je spolu s nimi. Dobrou chuť, fidli-fidli! Slovenský hudebně-naučný pořad

programme.title: Kikirikí
programme.desc: Kohoutek a slepička se stali nerozlučnými kamarády. Mají se velmi rádi, v noci spí vedle sebe na bidýlku a přes den spolu gazdují na dvoře. Kohoutek neustále něco vymýšlí, je nespokojený a slepička s ním všechno trpělivě řeší. Každý příběh v sobě ukrývá ponaučení, jak se stát lepším a neubližovat lidem, kteří nás mají rádi. Slovenská pohádka

programme.title: Sníček (4)
programme.desc: Hugo splní dětem každý sen! V noci snové víly přinášejí dětem sny. Ale co dělají přes den? Hugo se nudí, a tak si usmyslí, že Lucii a Damiána bude navštěvovat i během dne. Jelikož se však neumí v našem světě chovat, děti ho musí učit základy slušné výchovy. On jim za to vysvětlí, jak fungují nejznámější hodiny na světě Big Ben, a ukáže, jak žijí různá zvířata. Vezme je do džungle, pod mořskou hladinu, do vesmíru, a také do svého snového světa, kde je možné opravdu všechno.

programme.title: Zabij nudu!
programme.desc: Dochází vám fantazie, co dělat doma s dětmi? Je tu pořad, v němž dostanete návod, jak spolu smysluplně prožít společně strávený čas. A také jak vyrobit jedinečné věci, které oživí vaši domácnost. Zažijete přitom určitě spoustu zábavy! Jsou to věci funkční, dekorační nebo jen pro zábavu, například pomůcky do školy, pokladničky či žertovné ozdoby. Slovenský tvůrčí pořad

programme.title: Staré pověsti české (19)
programme.desc: Animované Staré pověsti české vznikly ve vlastní produkci televizí CS Film a CS Mini. Producenti televize hledali velký příběh, který by připomínal tradice a naši minulost. Jan Werich o Jiráskovi, podle jehož námětu byl seriál natočen, řekl: „Kdyby Jirásek žil v Hollywoodu, byl by milionář, protože měl výborné zápletky.“ Oslavoval český národ, ale ne na úkor jiných. Tu a tam zušlechťoval naši historii a prokládal ji sentimentálními příběhy, a tak nám ji přibližoval a činil bližší.

programme.title: O modrém autíčku (8)
programme.desc: Animovaný seriál o dobrodružstvích modrého autíčka a jeho kamarádů. Český animovaný seriál

programme.title: O Mikešovi (13)
programme.desc: Animovaný seriál O kocouru Mikešovi a jeho přátelích, podle knihy Josefa Lady. Československý animovaný seriál

programme.title: Já Baryk (1)
programme.desc: Dvanáct příběhů, z nichž každý je věnovaný vždy jednomu měsíci v roce a jednomu zvířeti, se kterým se dobromyslný pes Baryk ve svém okolí potká, to je spousta veselých i napínavých příhod.

programme.title: Broučci (8)
programme.desc: Animovaný loutkový seriál na motivy knihy Jana Karafiáta. Karafiátova kniha s ilustracemi Jiřího Trnky inspirovala už celou řadu adaptací a stále patří do zlatého fondu české dětské literatury. Tato filmová verze Broučků citlivě pracuje se známými hodnotami a snaží se je co nejvíce přiblížit dnešním dětem. Český animovaný loutkový seriál

programme.title: Pojďte pane, budeme si hrát (3)
programme.desc: Kreslený seriál o dvojici medvědů, kdy jeden je malý a hloupoučký. Druhý protáhlý a vychytralý s mlsným jazýčkem. Jednoho dne se potkali u Kolína a dali se do řeči. Po dlouhém klábosení o tom, jak měli geniální předky a příbuzné zjistí, že jsou bráchové a začnou si spolu hrát. Prožívají spolu mnohá dobrodružství a hry, které však nejsou ze strany toho většího zrovna čestnou zábavou. Ale malý medvídek to snáší vcelku dobře, a tak oba navozují řadu úsměvných situací...

programme.title: Žofka a její dobrodružství (11)
programme.desc: Veselé příběhy podnikavé opičky Žofky Orangutanové a jejích zvířecích kamarádů v zoologické zahradě. Československý animovaný seriál .

programme.title: O Dorotce (10)
programme.desc: Holčička Dorotka a její věrný kamarád papoušek Koko spolu prožívají různá veselá dobrodružství. Československý animovaný seriál

programme.title: Příběhy kocoura Modroočka (2)
programme.desc: Modroočko má jemný kožíšek, velikánské modré oči, dlouhé vlasy a hebký čumáček. Je to vzdělaný kocourek, který si píše deník a bydlí u svého pána, spisovatele. Objevuje svět kolem sebe a vypráví o všech svých dvounohých a čtyřnohých přátelích. Z díry v plotu ho zachrání nový přítel - kocour Bělovous, na dovolené získá další přátele - ježka Šramotu, loveckého psa Fouska a králíka Bílé Pírko. Také se seznámí s kočičkou Kiki a popere se kvůli ní s obrovským zlomyslným kocourem Žluťákem.

programme.title: Tisíc a jedna noc (12)
programme.desc: Animovaný seriál, jehož jednotlivé části vyprávějí příhody ze známé knihy Pohádky tisíce a jedné noci. Český animovaný seriál

programme.title: Osada Havranů
programme.desc: Dobrodružství chlapce, kterého přinesla bouřlivá řeka. První část filmové trilogie o příhodách malého chlapce z doby kamenné. Rozvodněná řeka přinese k osadě Havranů malého chlapce. Pravěcí lovci si všimnou havraního peří v jeho vlasech. Na základě posvátného znamení se Havranpírko stane členem rodu a vyrůstá pod vedením zkušeného lovce Sokola. Příběh Havranpírka, mladého hrdiny z doby kamenné, je obestřen tajemstvím - přinesla jej totiž rozvodněná řeka.

programme.title: Písničky Vlasty Buriana
programme.desc: Hudební pořad postavený na legendárních písničkách Vlasty Buriana. Pořadem provází populární imitátor Petr Martinák. Český hudební pořad

programme.title: Pouta
programme.desc: Hledání lidského štěstí a opravdové lásky. Venkovský veterinář se nechal spoutat maloměšťáckými konvencemi, které vládnou v rodině jeho manželky. Cítí se proto unavený - dokud nepozná novou lásku, navíc rozhodnut konečně uskutečnit i své dávné sny. Československé psychologické drama

programme.title: Kinosál
programme.desc: V pořadu o nových filmech v kinech každý týden informujeme o nejzajímavějších a nejočekávanějších titulech v naší distribuci. V krátkých reportážích se zaměříme na zákulisí vzniku filmů, kuriozity z natáčení a výpovědi tvůrců. Přineseme rozhovory s českými a slovenskými filmaři, kteří v našich končinách stále více natáčejí své autorské projekty, a zachytíme jejich tvůrčí atmosféru. Filmová publicistika

programme.title: Filmové minuty
programme.desc: Filmové minuty přinášejí souhrnné filmové zpravodajství ze světa filmu, aktuality, ocenění, výročí, nové a připravované projekty a mnoho dalšího z domova i ze zahraničí... Filmová publicistika

programme.title: Soukromá vichřice
programme.desc: Hořká komedie o manželství, nevěře a podivné lásce podle novely Vladimíra Párala s podtitulem Laboratorní zpráva ze života hmyzu. V Ústí nad Labem, městě plném chemických továren, se několik lidí rozhodlo změnit svůj zaběhnutý životní stereotyp. Jejich nová dobrodružství se ale velice brzy proměňují ve stereotyp nový, nudný a únavný. Sledujeme proměnlivé vztahy mezi manžely i milenci, dvojice se rozcházejí i scházejí, hádají se i usmiřují.

programme.title: Kinosál
programme.desc: V pořadu o nových filmech v kinech každý týden informujeme o nejzajímavějších a nejočekávanějších titulech v naší distribuci. programme.title: Bota jménem Melichar
programme.desc: Holky z naší školy a ti druzí. Úsměvný pohled do tříd jedné základní školy vypráví o problémech s přezouváním, zloději a botami. Žákům i pedagogům komplikuje výuku experimentální budova nové školy a časté povinné přezouvání. Prvňák Honzík odhalí zlodějku odložených svršků a bot. Tam, kde se bota jmenuje Melichar, je možný všechno. Školní komedie debutujícího režiséra Zdeňka Trošky s lehkou detektivní zápletkou.

programme.title: Svatopluk a jeho synové čili pravdivý konec Říše velkomoravské
programme.desc: Parafráze starého mýtu je pojatá jako vtipná parodie zkoumající příčiny pádu Velkomoravské říše. V této verzi má Svatopluk místo původních tří synů syny čtyři. Čtvrtý syn je hlupák, který použije hrubou sílu, aby získal trůn. Československý animovaný film

programme.title: Kinosál
programme.desc: V pořadu o nových filmech v kinech každý týden informujeme o nejzajímavějších a nejočekávanějších titulech v naší distribuci. programme.title: Svět, kde se žebrá
programme.desc: Hugo Haas v roli zámožného, ale lakomého žebráka. Invalidní žebrák Josef Dostál je ve skutečnosti majitelem činžovního domu a pečlivě schraňuje věno pro svoji schovanku Zorku. Úsměvná a optimistická komedie podle divadelní hry Edmonda Konráda. Jednoruký žebrák Josef Dostál si znamenitým žebravým uměním vydělal tolik, že mohl koupit pěkný dům, stát se váženým panem domácím a pečlivě schraňovat věno pro svoji schovanku.

programme.title: Vracenky
programme.desc: Úsměvný pohled na vážné časy. 50. léta. Desetiletý Honzík Domnosil a jeho malá sestřička Petruška přijíždějí z venkova do Prahy, aby tu žili se svou matkou, která je plně zapojena do budování šťastných zítřků a na výchovu dětí jí nezbývají síly a čas. Chlapce a jeho kamarády vychovává doba a městská ulice. Honzík prožívá typické klukovské trable a vnitřní zmatky, v nichž se střídá dětsky naivní víra v Boha s dětsky naivní vírou v Lenina.

programme.title: O Maryšce a vlčím hrádku
programme.desc: Příběh o odvaze, obětavosti a věrnosti chudé dívky Maryšky, která díky těmto vlastnostem vysvobodí z tajemného polorozpadlého hrádku zakletou kněžku a dvanáct panen. Podmanivá loutková pohádka, má dodnes velmi silnou, tajuplnou atmosféru a formou zpracování osloví i dospělé publikum. Československá animovaná pohádka

programme.title: Tři chlapi na cestách
programme.desc: Ouplavičtí zemědělci se pořádně rozšoupnou na výletě v plzeňském pivovaru i Karlových Varech. Obyvatelé Ouplavic se vydávají na dvoudenní zájezd, jehož součástí je nejen exkurze do západočeských zemědělských závodů a plzeňského pivovaru, ale také návštěva Karlových Varů. Mezi účastníky nechybějí ani děda Potůček a jeho syn Václav, předseda místního družstva, který právě prožívá osobní krizi. Je přesvědčen, že na vedoucí funkci už nestačí, a chce se jí vzdát.

programme.title: To není moje sestra!
programme.desc: Michal by byl nejradši, kdyby mu jeho nevlastní sestra Karin zmizela ze života. To ale ještě netuší, že budou na dětském hřišti společně čelit neznámému zákeřnému Zlu. Český krátkometrážní horor

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (37)
programme.desc: When Mr Bean discovers that his favourite TV action star is in town, he takes a photo to be autographed - but the queue to meet him is massive! So, using a couple of props, he disguises himself as a security guard to get to the front - but he is caught out. How will Mr Bean get his autograph before TV star rushes off to catch his plane?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (38)
programme.desc: Irma and Mr Bean are invited across the road for dinner, and Mr Paliwal is particularly keen to show off his brand-new white sofa. As Mr Bean tests it out, he feels the squish of a chocolate bar in his back pocket and realises it’s gone all over the white cushions. Can Mr Bean clean the sofa before anyone notices?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (74)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have found an Amerindian eagle amulet that endows he who wears it with the powers of a bird of prey. Grizzy would like to impress his beloved she-bear by soaring majestically through the sky. But to confiscate the magic totem from the Lemmings, who are now as sharp as eagles, Grizzy will have to use the cunning... of a puma.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (75)
programme.desc: The Lemmings are having a blast with the ranger's electric guitar and the cabin walls tremble with their experimental rock. Just as Grizzy is about to destroy the instrument, he realizes it can make harmonious sounds too. Will this be enough to seduce the she-bear he's in love with?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (76)
programme.desc: To finally be on an equal footing with Grizzy's imposing build and throw their own weight around in the cabin, the Lemmings decide to wear a blow-up sumotori costume.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (77)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings discover an ancient Amerindian table with the power to show you past events. They relive their prehistoric ancestors' first confrontations, and learn that chocolate spread was invented long, long ago.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (78)
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover an old book of magic spells with a formula that enables one to take on the appearance of any other creature. The Lemmings have the bright idea of transforming one their kin into a double of the she-bear Grizzy is madly in love with in order to trick him. How could Grizzy refuse to give his jar of chocolate spread to his sweetheart?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (1)
programme.desc: When Grizzy propels the Lemmings out of the log cabin perched on the Great Wall of China, the critters land on a small traditional house in a bamboo forest where they discover a box filled with fortune cookies. One Lemming gets super lucky after eating one. Armed with their magic cookies, the Lemmings set out to confront Grizzy. But each cookie represents a power… or a curse!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (2)
programme.desc: The Lemmings love sesame nougat but Grizzy, who adores this treat too, steals their box. Quite upset, the rodents search for more, in vain. Instead, they discover the art of energy points in an old Chinese medicine book. Determined to recover their sweets regardless of the cost, the Lemmings activate Grizzy's vital points and the bear finds himself completely blocked. Thanks to the book, Grizzy frees himself and learns to master energies in turn.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (3)
programme.desc: After a game that ends abruptly, the Lemmings fall onto the roof of a temple where they discover drawings of Tai Chi movements. When carried out, the exercises generate a ball of energy! The Lemmings test out the sequence of movements on… Grizzy, until he is evicted from the cabin and falls onto the temple in turn. His fall unveils a new sequence of movements on a fresco that could create an even stronger energy flow!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (4)
programme.desc: After being thrown out of the log cabin by Grizzy, the Lemmings find a dragon statue with a mysterious stone in a temple. Touching the stone makes a fleeting tattoo appear on their bellies, temporarily endowing them with the mastery of Shaolin Kung Fu. The Lemmings return to the cabin and uproot Grizzy with ease! But Grizzy has not said his last word and manages to get hold of the magic stone.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (5)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over the tablet. During their scuffle, they knock over an army crate which falls into the middle of the bamboo forest surrounding the cabin. Alerted by the noise, a peace missionary panda comes out of the forest and tries to calm down the worked-up adversaries. But will the limitless strategies of Grizzy and the Lemmings get the better of the panda's patience?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (6)
programme.desc: The Lemmings create a shadow puppet show where seven papercut lemmings confront a bear over a jar of Yummy chocolate spread. The Lemmings in the audience are super enthusiastic, but Grizzy is outraged by the treatment inflicted upon the bear. He decides to intervene and equips the paper bear with an armor and saber! The Lemmings retort with ninja effigies of themselves and mount an attack to recover the coveted jar of Yummy spread.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (7)
programme.desc: As Grizzy relaxes in the massage chair, a cloud drifts in front of the sun, immediately stopping the electricity supply in the log cabin. The voltage drops continue, even though the sky seems clear now. Grizzy looks out the window and a dragon appears on the horizon! Once over his initial fright, the bear realizes that it's only a kite flown by the Lemmings - using the electricity from the cabin they have rerouted!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (8)
programme.desc: Grizzy dismantles the toboggan built by the Lemmings in the log cabin and reemploys the bamboo sticks to build a jacuzzi. When the Lemmings discover the bear's piece of work, they imagine a giant waterpark dominated by an immense waterslide. Anticipating the Lemmings' desire, Grizzy tries to barricade himself inside but the rodents manage to eject him from the cabin. The bear comes back, protected by a super bamboo armor…

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (9)
programme.desc: The Lemmings organize a drone race throughout the cabin. Grizzy, who was on the verge of falling asleep, interrupts the competition but must contend with the rodents' reprisals. Thrown out of the cabin, the bear falls onto a temple dedicated to the Monkey King. He appropriates the statue's powers, operating a magic cloud by remote control. Grizzy settles in on the cloud and wins the race before the Lemmings. But a cloud that flies that fast can only arouse lust…

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (10)
programme.desc: To trick Grizzy's vigilance and steal the TV, the Lemmings, disguised as traditional Chinese dancers, perform a number that leaves the bear flabbergasted. The rodents take advantage of their diversion to carry off the TV set on their airborne craft made of Chinese umbrellas. But before they can escape with their bounty, Grizzy recovers the screen. Ever as determined, the Lemmings come back after upgrading their vessel.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (7)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is trying to watch the motor racing on TV, when Mrs Wicket interrupts him to offer a deal - revamp her garden with new paving and ornaments, and he’ll get a month’s rent for free. Bean reluctantly agrees, but when he sees Mr Paliwal finish a personal training session and keen for more, he offers him a new workout… doing all Mr Bean’s work for him while he watches the racing! Win, win!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (8)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is bored of queuing for a trampoline park, so secretly bounces in through a window using a trampette. But he soon gets on the wrong side of a young show-off boy who keeps stealing Teddy and throwing him in hard-to-reach spots. To settle their row, they agree on a race around the trampoline park - first place wins Teddy. Will Mr Bean triumph before he’s chucked out for jumping the queue?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (34)
programme.desc: When Mr. Wicket gets a new lodger who is an Inventor, and a big nuisance, Bean discovers that he has to become ‘inventive’ himself. But, when your enemy is clever and sneaky, you have to be even cleverer and sneakier. Bean has never lost ‘a cleverness competition’, but maybe there is a first time for everything!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (35)
programme.desc: Conned by a mechanic into believing his beloved car to be beyond repair, Mr. Bean reluctantly consigns his faithful four-wheeled friend to the car crusher. After choosing hot-air ballooning as an alternative mode of transport, he spots his cherished car from the air… with the unscrupulous mechanic whistling at the wheel! This discovery raises more than Mr. Bean’s spirits.

programme.title: Lamput (5)
programme.desc: The Boss takes on a particularly enormous sailor in a seedy underground arm wrestling tournament. Who knew old Boss such grit?

programme.title: Moley (34)
programme.desc: MoleTown has a spectacular fun fair and at its heart is a huge ferris wheel created by Mishmosh, but after Manny speeds things up, Moley has to save the day.

programme.title: Moley (35)
programme.desc: Mrs Moley is directing a small play, with Moley cast as the hero, but his fear gets the better of him and so Manny conjures up a spell which turns all residents into their characters, now Moley must save them for real.

programme.title: Moley (36)
programme.desc: Moley and the Gardener each head off for a road trip, leaving Manny and Squirm home alone, but it isn’t long before the two of them take an adventure of their own.

programme.title: Moley (37)
programme.desc: When Mrs Moley needs a wardobe picking up from Miss Petunia, Moley and Dotty must figure out how they can transport the beast from the other side of town.

programme.title: Moley (38)
programme.desc: Dotty persuades Moley and Mishmosh to head out for a spot of camping, meanwhile the Gardener has his own plans.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko (2)
programme.desc: Tom is taking selfies and enjoying a sweet snack at the candy shop, when Jerry and Tuffy sneak up and eat his strawberries. Tom proceeds to chase after them, but Tuffy falls into the claw machine. Jerry tries to save him, and Tom fishes them out. Tom makes Tuffy cry and apologizes by feeding him sweets.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (12)
programme.desc: So Mushpie can take a break, Mush-Mush, Chep and Lilit offer to look after the Mushies, assuring her that everything will be fine. But a Mushie pops to become a Mushlet and escapes. Our friends find him in Muddler's clutches! Now, they must figure out a way to save the Mushlet and return the other Mushies to their cave before the return of Mushpie.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (13)
programme.desc: The Mushlets love Mush-Mush's heroic stories. But when they demand to see him actually do something heroic, Mush-Mush feels he can't back out... and so ends up stuck up a cliff. Relieved to be rescued by Chep and Lilit, Mush-Mush is about to admit that he isn't a hero when the Mushlets find themselves in danger. Now Mush-Mush has no choice but to be a real hero!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (14)
programme.desc: Chanterelle has built a whistle that can reproduce the most beautiful sound of the forest: the one of the Nightingale. When the whistle disappears, Mush-Mush, Chep and Lilit soon discover that it has been stolen by a beetle. In order to finally hear what a real Nightingale sounds like, they'll have to get it back!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (15)
programme.desc: Wanting to rush off to climb Mush Mountain, Mush-Mush is in a hurry checking nectar level in flowers... a job that takes time and care. Soon Mush-Mush's haste causes disaster when he scares all the bees away. Now Mush-Mush and friends have to find a way to lure the bees back...

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (16)
